### FILE: next.config.ts
```ts
import type { NextConfig } from "next";

/* Vercel sets VERCEL=1 automatically. On Vercel we do NOT set output —
   Vercel handles the output format automatically for Next.js projects.
   EXPORT_STATIC is only for GitHub Pages builds (output: export). */
const isVercel = process.env.VERCEL === "1";
const isExport = !isVercel && process.env.EXPORT_STATIC === "true";
/* GitHub Pages doesn't have VERCEL set, so only GitHub Pages needs the
   /service-website basePath. */
const needsBasePath = isExport && !isVercel;

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  /* Only set output for non-Vercel builds (GitHub Pages static export).
     On Vercel, don't set output — Vercel handles it automatically. */
  ...(isExport ? { output: "export" as const } : {}),
  ...(needsBasePath ? { basePath: "/service-website" } : {}),
  images: {
    unoptimized: isExport,
  },
  env: {
    NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH: needsBasePath ? "/service-website" : "",
  },
  typescript: {
    ignoreBuildErrors: true,
  },
  reactStrictMode: false,
};

export default nextConfig;
```

### FILE: prisma/schema.prisma
```prisma
// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

// Looking for ways to speed up your queries, or scale easily with your serverless or edge functions?
// Try Prisma Accelerate: https://pris.ly/cli/accelerate-init

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  email     String   @unique
  name      String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Post {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  title     String
  content   String?
  published Boolean  @default(false)
  authorId  String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model ContactSubmission {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  email     String
  storeUrl  String   @default("")
  budget    String   @default("")
  message   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}
model ContactMessage {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  type      String   @default("contact") // contact | quick | booking
  name      String
  email     String
  phone     String?
  website   String?
  service   String?
  budget    String?
  revenue   String?
  country   String?
  city      String?
  timing    String?
  notes     String?
  message   String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}
```

```tsx
   UTILITY COMPONENTS
   ────────────────────────────────────────── */

function useScrollReveal() {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('active');
            io.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px' }
    );
    io.observe(el);
    // also observe any reveal descendants inside (premium + classic)
    const inner = el.querySelectorAll('.reveal, .reveal-stagger, .reveal-up, .reveal-left, .reveal-right, .reveal-scale, .reveal-fade, .count-up');
    inner.forEach((node) => io.observe(node));
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return ref;
}

function Counter({ target, prefix = '', suffix = '' }: { target: number; prefix?: string; suffix?: string }) {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const hasAnimated = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const runAnimation = () => {
      if (hasAnimated.current) return;
      hasAnimated.current = true;
      const duration = 2000;
      const start = performance.now();
      const animate = (now: number) => {
        const elapsed = now - start;
        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
        const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
        setCount(eased * target);
        if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      };
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    };
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          runAnimation();
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.1 }
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    // Fallback: start animation after 3s even if observer doesn't fire
    const fallback = setTimeout(runAnimation, 3000);
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      clearTimeout(fallback);
    };
  }, [target]);

  // Format: integers use toLocaleString, decimals keep up to 2 decimals (strip trailing zeros)
  const display = Number.isInteger(target)
    ? Math.floor(count).toLocaleString()
    : parseFloat(count.toFixed(2)).toString();
  return <span ref={ref}>{prefix}{display}{suffix}</span>;
}

/* Renders the "Best For" text with a styled "rev" shortform tag
   inserted right after the revenue figure (the "/mo" part). */
function BestForText({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const idx = text.indexOf('/mo');
  if (idx === -1) return <>{text}</>;
  const before = text.slice(0, idx + 3);
  const after = text.slice(idx + 3).trimStart();
  return (
    <>
      {before} <span className="rev-tag">rev</span> {after}
    </>
  );
}

/* Renders promise text with **bold** segments and \n\n paragraph breaks. */
function PromiseText({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const paragraphs = text.split("\n\n");
  return (
    <>
      {paragraphs.map((para, pi) => {
        const parts = para.split(/(\*\*[^*]+\*\*)/g);
        return (
          <span key={pi}>
            {pi > 0 && (
              <>
                <br />
                <br />
              </>
            )}
            {parts.map((part, i) =>
              part.startsWith("**") && part.endsWith("**") ? (
                <strong key={i} className="font-semibold text-white">{part.slice(2, -2)}</strong>
              ) : (
                <React.Fragment key={i}>{part}</React.Fragment>
              )
            )}
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

function Navbar() {
  const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);
  const [mobileOpen, setMobileOpen] = useState(false);
  const [mobileServicesOpen, setMobileServicesOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState('');
  const servicesHoverTimeout = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const [servicesOpen, setServicesOpen] = useState(false);
  const aboutHoverTimeout = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const [aboutOpen, setAboutOpen] = useState(false);
  const [mobileAboutOpen, setMobileAboutOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onScroll = () => setScrolled(window.scrollY > 50);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });

    // Active section tracking
    // Merge NAV_LINKS IDs + About submenu IDs (what-we-do, why-were-different, about-founder)
    // so scroll-spy highlights the parent "About" item when in any of those sections.
    // Filter out items without href and cross-page links (starting with '/').
    const sectionIds = Array.from(new Set([
      ...NAV_LINKS.map(l => l.href.replace('#', '')),
      ...ABOUT_SUBMENU.filter(l => l.href && l.href.startsWith('#')).map(l => l.href.replace('#', '')),
    ]));
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            setActiveSection('#' + entry.target.id);
          }
        });
      },
      { rootMargin: '-20% 0px -60% 0px' }
    );
    sectionIds.forEach(id => {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) observer.observe(el);
    });

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
      observer.disconnect();
    };
  }, []);

  // Desktop hover handlers with small delay so the dropdown stays open
  // while the cursor moves from "Services" into the dropdown panel.
  const openServices = () => {
    if (servicesHoverTimeout.current) clearTimeout(servicesHoverTimeout.current);
    setServicesOpen(true);
  };
  const closeServices = () => {
    if (servicesHoverTimeout.current) clearTimeout(servicesHoverTimeout.current);
    servicesHoverTimeout.current = setTimeout(() => setServicesOpen(false), 150);
  };

  // Mirror the Services hover handlers for the About dropdown.
  const openAbout = () => {
    if (aboutHoverTimeout.current) clearTimeout(aboutHoverTimeout.current);
    setAboutOpen(true);
  };
  const closeAbout = () => {
    if (aboutHoverTimeout.current) clearTimeout(aboutHoverTimeout.current);
    aboutHoverTimeout.current = setTimeout(() => setAboutOpen(false), 150);
  };

  // Close the About dropdown on Escape and on click outside (accessibility).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!aboutOpen) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setAboutOpen(false);
    };
    const onDocClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
      if (!target.closest('.nav-about-wrap')) setAboutOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDocClick);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDocClick);
    };
  }, [aboutOpen]);

  return (
    <>
      <nav
        className={`fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 transition-all duration-300 ${
          scrolled
            ? 'bg-[rgba(0,0,0,0.92)] backdrop-blur-xl shadow-lg'
            : 'bg-transparent'
        }`}
        style={{ borderBottom: scrolled ? '1px solid rgba(0,198,255,0.08)' : 'none' }}
      >
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 relative flex items-center justify-between h-[72px]">
          <a href="#hero" className="flex items-center gap-3 group z-10">

function HeroSection() {
  const [typedText, setTypedText] = useState('');
  const fullText = 'Your Store Is Making Revenue. Something Else Is Keeping The Profit.';
  const typingDone = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typingDone.current) return;
    let i = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (i < fullText.length) {
        setTypedText(fullText.slice(0, i + 1));
        i++;
      } else {
        typingDone.current = true;
        clearInterval(timer);
      }
    }, 30);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  return (
    <section id="hero" className="relative min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
      {/* Dark Overlay */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.96) 0%, rgba(8,13,20,0.92) 100%)' }} />
      {/* Grid Pattern */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 grid-bg" />

      <div className="relative z-10 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-32 text-center">
        {/* Floating Particles */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none" aria-hidden="true">
          {[...Array(12)].map((_, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              className="hero-particle"
              style={{
                left: `${8 + (i * 7.5) % 85}%`,
                top: `${15 + (i * 11) % 70}%`,
                animationDelay: `${i * 0.7}s`,
                animationDuration: `${6 + (i % 4) * 2}s`,
                width: `${3 + (i % 3) * 2}px`,
                height: `${3 + (i % 3) * 2}px`,
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Pre-Headline */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mb-6">
          <div className="w-12 h-[2px] bg-[#00C6FF]" />
          <span className="section-label">For E-Commerce Founders Who Are Selling More, But Keeping Less.</span>
        </div>

        {/* Main Headline */}
        <h1 className="hero-headline mb-6">
          {typedText}
          <span className="inline-block w-[3px] h-[0.8em] bg-[#00C6FF] ml-1 align-middle" style={{ animation: 'blink 1s infinite' }} />
        </h1>

        {/* Sub-Headline */}
        <span className="section-label max-w-[620px] mx-auto block mb-10 leading-relaxed hero-sub-headline">
          MozIntelligence finds exactly where your money is leaking across your products, your ads, and your customers and shows you how to stop it. No confusing reports. No generic advice. Just a clear picture of what is hurting your profit and a specific plan to fix it.
        </span>

        {/* CTA Buttons */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-4 mb-14">
          <a
            href="https://calendar.app.google/TGnzfC65zBF3hVeD9"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="btn-press px-8 py-3.5 rounded-md text-base font-semibold text-[#000000] transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,198,255,0.4)]"
            style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #00C6FF, #0072FF)', boxShadow: '0 0 20px rgba(0,198,255,0.3)' }}
          >
            Find My Profit Leaks, Free 20-Min Call
          </a>
          <a
            href="#case-studies"
            className="btn-press px-8 py-3.5 rounded-md text-base font-medium text-[#00C6FF] border border-[rgba(0,198,255,0.3)] transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-[rgba(0,198,255,0.1)] hover:border-[#00C6FF] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,198,255,0.15)]"
          >
            See Client Results
          </a>
        </div>

        {/* Trust Bar */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
          {TRUST_STATS.map((stat, i) => (
            <div key={i} className={`hero-stat-card glass rounded-xl p-4 text-center transition-all duration-300 hover:border-[rgba(0,198,255,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,198,255,0.1)]`} style={{ animationDelay: `${0.3 + i * 0.15}s` }}>
              {stat.isRating ? (
                <>
                  <div className="hero-rating-stars text-xl sm:text-2xl leading-none" title="4.9 out of 5 stars">
                    {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((s) => (
                      <span key={s} className="hero-star" style={{ animationDelay: `${0.8 + s * 0.15}s` }}><Star size={20} className="inline-block" fill="currentColor" /></span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <div className="font-bold text-white text-sm mt-1.5">
                    <Counter target={stat.target || 0} prefix={stat.prefix || ''} suffix={stat.suffix || '/5'} />
                  </div>
                  {stat.ratingLabel && <div className="text-[#8899AA] text-xs mt-0.5 uppercase">{stat.ratingLabel}</div>}
                </>
              ) : stat.isPrivacy ? (
                <>
                  <div className="gradient-text text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold leading-tight">
                    <Counter target={stat.target || 0} prefix={stat.prefix || ''} suffix={stat.suffix || '%'} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[#8899AA] text-xs mt-1 uppercase">{stat.label}</div>
                </>
              ) : stat.isDeadline ? (
                <>
                  <div className="gradient-text text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold leading-tight uppercase">On time</div>
                  <div className="text-[#8899AA] text-xs mt-1 uppercase">{stat.label}</div>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div className="gradient-text text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold">
                    <Counter target={stat.target || 0} prefix={stat.prefix || ''} suffix={stat.suffix || ''} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[#8899AA] text-xs mt-1 uppercase">{stat.label}</div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Scroll Indicator */}
        <div className="mt-16 flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-[#445566] text-xs tracking-widest uppercase">Scroll</span>
          <ChevronDown className="text-[#00C6FF] animate-bounce" size={20} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────

export default function PortfolioPage() {
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [showBackToTop, setShowBackToTop] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    /* Scroll progress + back-to-top */
    const onScroll = () => {
      const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
      const docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
      setProgress(docHeight > 0 ? (scrollTop / docHeight) * 100 : 0);
      setShowBackToTop(scrollTop > 600);
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });

    /* Scroll reveal — activate reveal elements as they enter view */
    const REVEAL_SELECTOR = '.reveal, .reveal-stagger, .reveal-up, .reveal-left, .reveal-right, .reveal-scale, .reveal-fade, .count-up, .sg-sk-text';
    let revealIO: IntersectionObserver | null = null;
    const checkReveals = () => {
      document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(REVEAL_SELECTOR).forEach((el) => {
        if (el.classList.contains('active')) return;
        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const vh = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
        if (rect.top < vh - 60 && rect.bottom > 0) {
          el.classList.add('active');
          revealIO?.unobserve(el);
        }
      });
    };
    revealIO = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.classList.add('active');
            revealIO?.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -60px 0px' }
    );
    document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(REVEAL_SELECTOR).forEach((el) => revealIO!.observe(el));
    window.addEventListener('scroll', checkReveals, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', checkReveals);
    // Activate anything already in view (after a short delay for hydration)
    const t1 = window.setTimeout(checkReveals, 100);
    const t2 = window.setTimeout(checkReveals, 600);
    if (document.readyState === 'complete') window.setTimeout(checkReveals, 50);
    else window.addEventListener('load', checkReveals);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', checkReveals);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', checkReveals);
      window.removeEventListener('load', checkReveals);
      window.clearTimeout(t1);
      window.clearTimeout(t2);
      revealIO?.disconnect();
    };
  }, []);

  const scrollToTop = useCallback(() => {
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, []);

  const scrollToFooter = useCallback(() => {
    const footer = document.getElementById('footer');
    if (footer) {
      footer.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    } else {
      // Fallback: scroll to the very bottom of the page
      window.scrollTo({ top: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen flex flex-col">
      {/* Scroll Progress */}
      <div id="scroll-progress" style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />

      <Navbar />
      <HeroSection />
      <WhyDataSection />
      <PlatformsShowcaseSection />
      <QuickProofSection />
      <DashboardShowcaseSection />
      <WhatWeDoSection />
      <PrinciplesSection />
      <WhyDifferentSection />
      <ServicesSection />
      <CaseStudiesSection />
      {/* CaseStudies2Section removed — all 6 cards now in #case-studies */}
      <TechnicalPortfolioSection />
      <TestimonialsSection />
      <ProcessSection />
      <TechStackSection />
      <FaqSection />
      <CtaBanner />
      <SiteFooter />
      <MobileStickyBar />

      {/* Back to Top */}
      <button
        onClick={scrollToTop}
        className={`back-to-top ${showBackToTop ? 'visible' : ''}`}
        aria-label="Back to top"
      >
        <ChevronDown size={20} style={{ transform: 'rotate(180deg)' }} />
      </button>

      {/* Back to Footer — matching floating button below Back-to-Top */}
      <button
        onClick={scrollToFooter}
        className={`back-to-footer ${showBackToTop ? 'visible' : ''}`}
        aria-label="Back to footer"
      >
        <ChevronDown size={20} />
      </button>

      {/* MozIntelligence AI Chatbot */}
      <ChatbotWidget />
    </main>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { MetadataRoute } from "next";

export default function robots(): MetadataRoute.Robots {
  return {
    rules: [
      {
        userAgent: "*",
        allow: "/",
        disallow: ["/api/"],
      },
    ],
    sitemap: "https://mozintelligence.vercel.app/sitemap.xml",
  };
}
```

```tsx
export const dynamicParams = false;

export function generateStaticParams() {
  return blogPosts.map((post) => ({ slug: post.slug }));
}

export async function generateMetadata({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const post = getBlogPost(slug);
  if (!post) return {};
  return {
    title: `${post.title} | MozIntelligence Blog`,
    description: post.excerpt,
    alternates: { canonical: `/blog/${post.slug}` },
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Blog posts - original editorial content for the MozIntelligence blog.
 *
 * Structure: each post is a sequence of typed blocks so the renderer in
 * /blog/[slug] can style headings, paragraphs, lists and callouts without
 * a markdown dependency. New posts: append to `blogPosts`.
 */

export type BlogBlock =
  | { type: "paragraph"; text: string }
  | { type: "heading"; text: string }
  | { type: "subheading"; text: string }
  | { type: "list"; items: string[] }
  | { type: "image"; src: string; alt: string; caption: string }
  | { type: "callout"; text: string }
  | { type: "table"; headers: string[]; rows: string[][] };

export interface BlogPost {
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  excerpt: string;
  category: string;
  date: string;
  readTime: string;
  author: { name: string; role: string };
  coverImage: string;
  coverAlt: string;
  content: BlogBlock[];
}
```

```tsx
interface FormData { full_name: string; email: string; phone: string; website_url: string; service_package: string; monthly_revenue: string; country: string; city: string; preferred_time: string; additional_notes: string; }
interface FormErrors { [key: string]: string }
const INITIAL_FORM: FormData = { full_name: '', email: '', phone: '', website_url: '', service_package: '', monthly_revenue: '', country: '', city: '', preferred_time: '', additional_notes: '' };

const inputClass = "w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-[16px] text-[#0F172A] placeholder:text-[15px] placeholder:text-[#94A3B8] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0072FF] focus:bg-white transition-all";

function BookingPageContent() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const packageSlug = searchParams.get('package') || '';
  const defaultPackage = PACKAGE_MAP[packageSlug] || '';

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<FormData>(INITIAL_FORM);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<FormErrors>({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitStatus, setSubmitStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');

  useEffect(() => { if (defaultPackage) setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, service_package: defaultPackage })); }, [defaultPackage]);

  const validate = (): boolean => {
    const e: FormErrors = {};
    if (!formData.full_name.trim()) e.full_name = 'Full Name is required.';
    if (!formData.email.trim()) e.email = 'Email Address is required.';
    else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(formData.email.trim())) e.email = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
    if (!formData.website_url.trim()) e.website_url = 'Please enter your website URL.';
    else if (!/^https?:\/\/.+\..+/.test(formData.website_url.trim())) e.website_url = 'Please enter a valid URL.';
    if (!formData.service_package) e.service_package = 'Please select a service package.';
    if (!formData.monthly_revenue) e.monthly_revenue = 'Please select your estimated monthly revenue.';
    if (!formData.country) e.country = 'Please select your country.';
    setErrors(e); return Object.keys(e).length === 0;
  };

  const handleChange = (field: keyof FormData, value: string) => { setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value })); if (errors[field]) setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: '' })); };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); if (isSubmitting) return; if (!validate()) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true); setSubmitStatus('idle');
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/booking', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ ...formData, source_package: defaultPackage }) });
      const data = await response.json();
      if (data.success) setSubmitStatus('success'); else throw new Error(data.error || 'Submission failed');
    } catch (error) { console.error('Booking error:', error); setSubmitStatus('error'); } finally { setIsSubmitting(false); }
  };

  // Success state
  if (submitStatus === 'success') {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F8FAFC] flex items-center justify-center p-6">
        <div className="max-w-lg w-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl p-8 sm:p-12 text-center" style={{ border: '1px solid #E2E8F0' }}>
          <div className="w-20 h-20 mx-auto mb-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center" style={{ background: '#F0FDF4' }}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={40} className="text-[#22C55E]" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-[#0F172A] mb-3">Booking Request Received</h1>
          <p className="text-[#64748B] text-base mb-2">Thank you! We've successfully received your booking request.</p>
          <p className="text-[#64748B] text-sm mb-8">Mozahidul will personally review your submission and contact you within 24 hours.</p>
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 justify-center">
            <a href="/" className="px-6 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:scale-105" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #00C6FF, #0072FF)' }}>Return to Home</a>
            <button onClick={() => { setSubmitStatus('idle'); setFormData(INITIAL_FORM); if (defaultPackage) setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, service_package: defaultPackage })); }} className="px-6 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold text-[#0072FF] transition-all hover:bg-[#F0F7FF]" style={{ border: '1px solid #BFDBFE' }}>Book Another Service</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F8FAFC] flex flex-col">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-[#E2E8F0]" style={{ height: '72px' }}>
        <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 h-full flex items-center justify-between">
          <a href="/" className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Image src="/images/logo.png" alt="MozIntelligence Logo" width={38} height={38} className="rounded-lg" priority />
            <span className="text-xl font-bold text-[#0F172A] tracking-tight">MozIntelligence</span>
          </a>
          <a href="/" className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-[#475569] bg-white transition-all hover:bg-[#F8FAFC] hover:shadow-sm" style={{ border: '1px solid #E2E8F0' }}>
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
            Back to Home
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Centered booking form */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center px-6 py-8 sm:py-12">
        <div className="w-full max-w-3xl">
          {/* Title */}
          <div className="text-center mb-8">
            <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-[31px] font-bold text-[#0F172A] mb-2 tracking-tight">Book Your Free Strategy Call</h1>
            <p className="text-[15px] text-[#64748B]">Fill in your details and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.</p>
          </div>

          {/* Form Card — slightly wider for new fields */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-10 shadow-lg" style={{ border: '1px solid #E2E8F0' }}>
            {submitStatus === 'error' && (
              <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2 text-sm bg-[#FEF2F2]" style={{ border: '1px solid #FECACA' }}>
                <AlertCircle size={16} className="text-[#EF4444] flex-shrink-0" />
                <span className="text-[#EF4444]">Something went wrong while submitting your request. Please try again.</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
              {/* Row 1: Full Name | Email */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>Full Name <span className="text-[#EF4444]">*</span></label>
                  <input type="text" value={formData.full_name} onChange={e => handleChange('full_name', e.target.value)} placeholder="John Smith"
                    className={inputClass} style={{ borderColor: errors.full_name ? '#EF4444' : '#E2E8F0' }} />
                  {errors.full_name && <p className="text-[#EF4444] text-xs mt-1">{errors.full_name}</p>}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>Email Address <span className="text-[#EF4444]">*</span></label>
                  <input type="email" value={formData.email} onChange={e => handleChange('email', e.target.value)} placeholder="john@company.com"
                    className={inputClass} style={{ borderColor: errors.email ? '#EF4444' : '#E2E8F0' }} />
                  {errors.email && <p className="text-[#EF4444] text-xs mt-1">{errors.email}</p>}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Row 2: Phone | Website URL */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>Phone / WhatsApp</label>
                  <input type="tel" value={formData.phone} onChange={e => handleChange('phone', e.target.value)} placeholder="+1 234 567 890"
                    className={inputClass} style={{ borderColor: '#E2E8F0' }} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>Website / Store URL <span className="text-[#EF4444]">*</span></label>
                  <input type="url" value={formData.website_url} onChange={e => handleChange('website_url', e.target.value)} placeholder="https://yourstore.com"
                    className={inputClass} style={{ borderColor: errors.website_url ? '#EF4444' : '#E2E8F0' }} />
                  {errors.website_url && <p className="text-[#EF4444] text-xs mt-1">{errors.website_url}</p>}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Service Package */}
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Service Package <span className="text-[#EF4444]">*</span></label>
                <select value={formData.service_package} onChange={e => handleChange('service_package', e.target.value)}
                  className={`${inputClass} cursor-pointer`}
                  style={{ borderColor: errors.service_package ? '#EF4444' : '#E2E8F0' }}>
                  <option value="">Select a service package...</option>
                  {SERVICE_PACKAGES.map((g, i) => (
                    <optgroup key={i} label={g.label}>
                      {g.options.map(p => <option key={p} value={p}>{p}</option>)}
                    </optgroup>
                  ))}
                </select>
                {errors.service_package && <p className="text-[#EF4444] text-xs mt-1">{errors.service_package}</p>}
              </div>

              {/* Row 3: Revenue | Preferred Time */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>Estimated Monthly Revenue <span className="text-[#EF4444]">*</span></label>
                  <select value={formData.monthly_revenue} onChange={e => handleChange('monthly_revenue', e.target.value)}

                    style={{ borderColor: errors.monthly_revenue ? '#EF4444' : '#E2E8F0' }}>
                    <option value="">Select range...</option>
                    {REVENUE_RANGES.map(r => <option key={r} value={r}>{r}</option>)}
                  </select>

                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Row 4: Country | City (NEW) */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>Country <span className="text-[#EF4444]">*</span></label>
                  <select value={formData.country} onChange={e => handleChange('country', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${inputClass} cursor-pointer`}
                    style={{ borderColor: errors.country ? '#EF4444' : '#E2E8F0' }}>
                    <option value="">Select Country</option>
                    {COUNTRIES.map(c => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
                  </select>
                  {errors.country && <p className="text-[#EF4444] text-xs mt-1">{errors.country}</p>}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>City / State</label>
                  <input type="text" value={formData.city} onChange={e => handleChange('city', e.target.value)} placeholder="City / State"
                    className={inputClass} style={{ borderColor: '#E2E8F0' }} />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Additional Notes */}
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Additional Notes / Anything else</label>
                <textarea value={formData.additional_notes} onChange={e => handleChange('additional_notes', e.target.value)} placeholder="Tell us about your specific needs or questions..." rows={3}
                  className="w-full bg-[#F8FAFC] border rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-[16px] text-[#0F172A] placeholder:text-[15px] placeholder:text-[#94A3B8] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#0072FF] focus:bg-white transition-all resize-none"
                  style={{ borderColor: '#E2E8F0' }} />
              </div>

              {/* Submit */}
              <button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-6 py-4 rounded-xl text-[16px] font-bold text-white transition-all hover:scale-[1.02] disabled:opacity-60 disabled:hover:scale-100"
                style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #00C6FF, #0072FF)', boxShadow: '0 4px 15px rgba(0,114,255,0.3)' }}>
                {isSubmitting ? (<><Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" /> Submitting...</>) : (<>Submit Booking Request <ArrowRight size={16} /></>)}
              </button>
              <p className="text-center text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">🔒 Your information is secure and will never be shared.</p>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function BookPage() {
```

### FILE: src/app/analytics-partner-retainer/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/analytics-partner-retainer/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

```tsx
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import LandingContent from "./landing-content";
import "./landing.css";

export default function Page() {
  const bodyHtml = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "data-driven-growth-system", "landing-body.html"),
    "utf-8"
  );
  const scriptCode = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "data-driven-growth-system", "landing-script.js"),
    "utf-8"
  );

  return <LandingContent bodyHtml={bodyHtml} scriptCode={scriptCode} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/data-driven-growth-system/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/data-driven-growth-system/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

### FILE: src/app/health-check/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);
```

### FILE: src/app/health-check/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

```tsx
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import LandingContent from "./landing-content";
import "./landing.css";

export default function Page() {
  const bodyHtml = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "revenue-growth-accelerator", "landing-body.html"),
    "utf-8"
  );
  const scriptCode = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "revenue-growth-accelerator", "landing-script.js"),
    "utf-8"
  );

  return <LandingContent bodyHtml={bodyHtml} scriptCode={scriptCode} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/revenue-growth-accelerator/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/revenue-growth-accelerator/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

```tsx
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import LandingContent from "./landing-content";
import "./landing.css";

export default function Page() {
  const bodyHtml = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "cro-audit", "landing-body.html"),
    "utf-8"
  );
  const scriptCode = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "cro-audit", "landing-script.js"),
    "utf-8"
  );

  return <LandingContent bodyHtml={bodyHtml} scriptCode={scriptCode} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/cro-audit/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/cro-audit/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

```tsx
    "utf-8"
  );
  const scriptCode = fs.readFileSync(

}
```

### FILE: src/app/customer-retention-audit/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/customer-retention-audit/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

```tsx
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import LandingContent from "./landing-content";
import "./landing.css";

export default function Page() {

    "utf-8"
  );
  const scriptCode = fs.readFileSync(

  );

  return <LandingContent bodyHtml={bodyHtml} scriptCode={scriptCode} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/e-commerce-tracking-attribution-review/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { BookingModal } from "@/components/booking-modal";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  const [bookingOpen, setBookingOpen] = useState(false);
  const [bookingPackage, setBookingPackage] = useState<string>("");

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  // Listen for clicks on booking modal trigger buttons
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClick = (e: Event) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
      const trigger = target.closest(".booking-modal-trigger");
      if (trigger) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const pkg = trigger.getAttribute("data-package") || "";
        setBookingPackage(pkg);
        setBookingOpen(true);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener("click", handleClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("click", handleClick);
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />
      <BookingModal
        isOpen={bookingOpen}
        onClose={() => setBookingOpen(false)}
        defaultPackage={bookingPackage}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### FILE: src/app/e-commerce-tracking-attribution-review/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

### FILE: src/app/marketing-spend-audit/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { BookingModal } from "@/components/booking-modal";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  const [bookingOpen, setBookingOpen] = useState(false);
  const [bookingPackage, setBookingPackage] = useState<string>("");

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  // Listen for clicks on booking modal trigger buttons
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClick = (e: Event) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
      const trigger = target.closest(".booking-modal-trigger");
      if (trigger) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const pkg = trigger.getAttribute("data-package") || "";
        setBookingPackage(pkg);
        setBookingOpen(true);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener("click", handleClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("click", handleClick);
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />
      <BookingModal
        isOpen={bookingOpen}
        onClose={() => setBookingOpen(false)}
        defaultPackage={bookingPackage}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### FILE: src/app/marketing-spend-audit/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

### FILE: src/app/meta-ads-performance-audit/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```

```html
<section class="section" id="faq">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head center reveal">
      <span class="section-label">FAQ</span>
      <h2 class="section-title">Common Questions</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-list">
      <div class="faq-item reveal">
        <button class="faq-q">
          Who is this review for?
          <span class="faq-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg></span>
        </button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>This review is best suited for Shopify and DTC brands relying heavily on Meta Ads, brands spending approximately $3,000–$5,000+ per month on Meta, accounts with at least 60–90 days of campaign data, brands experiencing rising CAC or declining efficiency, brands preparing to scale, and brands whose Meta, Shopify, and GA4 numbers do not align. This review may not be suitable for accounts with no active Meta campaigns, very low conversion volume, brands looking for daily ad management, brands looking for creative production only, or brands expecting guaranteed ROAS improvement.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item reveal">
        <button class="faq-q">
          What data access is required?
          <span class="faq-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg></span>
        </button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>Depending on scope, access may be required to Meta Ads Manager, Meta Events Manager, Shopify, GA4, Google Tag Manager, product-cost or contribution-margin data, customer/order history if LTV is requested, and existing campaign and creative reports.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item reveal">
        <button class="faq-q">
          Will you manage my Meta Ads after the review?
          <span class="faq-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg></span>
        </button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>No. This is a measurement, profitability, and decision review. Campaign management can be scoped separately.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item reveal">
        <button class="faq-q">
          Do you guarantee higher ROAS?
          <span class="faq-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg></span>
        </button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>No. The review identifies performance opportunities and measurement issues, but results depend on implementation, market conditions, creative quality, offer, landing page, and auction dynamics.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item reveal">
        <button class="faq-q">
          Is the dashboard included?
          <span class="faq-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg></span>
        </button>
        <div class="faq-a"><p>No. The core deliverable is the report, scorecards, economics view, and action roadmap. A dashboard is available as a separate upgrade.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="faq-item reveal">
```

### FILE: src/app/meta-ads-performance-audit/landing-script.js
```js

  // ============ SCROLL REVEAL ============
  const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(entry=>{
      if(entry.isIntersecting){
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  },{threshold:0.12,rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px 0px'});
  revealEls.forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));

  // ============ FAQ ACCORDION ============
  const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
  faqItems.forEach(item=>{
    const btn = item.querySelector('.faq-q');
    btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
      faqItems.forEach(i=>i.classList.remove('open'));
      if(!isOpen) item.classList.add('open');
    });
  });

  // ============ SMOOTH ANCHOR ============
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a=>{
    a.addEventListener('click',e=>{
      const id = a.getAttribute('href');
      if(id.length>1){
        const target = document.querySelector(id);
        if(target){
          e.preventDefault();
          const offset = 70;
          const y = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - offset;
          window.scrollTo({top:y,behavior:'smooth'});
        }
      }
    });
  });

  // ============ NAV ACTIVE STATE ============
  const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');
  const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a');
  const navObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(entry=>{
      if(entry.isIntersecting){
        const id = entry.target.id;
        navLinks.forEach(l=>{
          l.style.color = l.getAttribute('href')==='#'+id ? 'var(--accent)' : '';
          l.style.background = l.getAttribute('href')==='#'+id ? 'var(--accent-soft)' : '';
        });
      }
    });
  },{rootMargin:'-40% 0px -55% 0px'});
  sections.forEach(s=>navObserver.observe(s));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   INTEGRATION FIXES — Next.js App Router (scoped to this route)
   These rules are appended to make the author's standalone-HTML
   design render correctly inside the App Router layout. They do
   NOT change any colors, fonts, spacing, or visual proportions.
   ============================================================ */
/* 1. The author's `body{overflow-x:hidden}` guard targets <body>,
   but in the App Router the horizontal scroll container is
   documentElement (<html>). Mirror the guard so wide tables
   don't create a page-level scrollbar on mobile. */
html{overflow-x:hidden}
/* 2. CSS grid items default to min-width:auto, which prevents the
   analysis-grid columns from shrinking below the intrinsic
   min-width of the .data-table (560px). Setting min-width:0 lets
   the author's .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} scroll wide tables
   internally instead of expanding the page. */
.analysis-text,.analysis-visual{min-width:0}
@media (max-width:1024px){
  .analysis-grid,.analysis-grid.reverse{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
}
```

```tsx
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import LandingContent from "./landing-content";
import "./landing.css";

export default function Page() {
  const bodyHtml = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "operations-efficiency-audit", "landing-body.html"),
    "utf-8"
  );
  const scriptCode = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "operations-efficiency-audit", "landing-script.js"),
    "utf-8"
  );

  return <LandingContent bodyHtml={bodyHtml} scriptCode={scriptCode} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/operations-efficiency-audit/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/operations-efficiency-audit/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

### FILE: src/app/product-portfolio-audit/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```
