### FILE: src/app/product-portfolio-audit/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

```tsx
import LandingContent from "./landing-content";

    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "profitability-audit", "landing-body.html"),
    "utf-8"
  );
  const scriptCode = fs.readFileSync(

}
```

### FILE: src/app/profitability-audit/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```

```html
          <p>We calculate the contribution margin of each product after accounting for the major costs behind every sale. This reveals which products are genuinely profitable and which high-revenue products may be generating surprisingly little profit.</p>

          <div class="insight-box" style="margin-top: 12px;"><b>Strategic Recommendation:</b> Review pricing, costs, and marketing spend on high-revenue, low-margin products before continuing to scale them.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="chart-mock">
          <div class="kpi-grid">
            <div class="kpi-card"><div class="kpi-label">Product A Revenue</div><div class="kpi-val">$42K</div><div class="kpi-sub" style="color: var(--danger);">Margin: 2%</div></div>
            <div class="kpi-card"><div class="kpi-label">Product B Revenue</div><div class="kpi-val">$28K</div><div class="kpi-sub">Margin: 35%</div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="bar-chart" style="margin-top: 16px;">
            <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-label">Product B</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill success" style="width: 70%;"></div></div><span class="bar-value">35%</span></div>
            <div class="bar-row"><span class="bar-label">Product A</span><div class="bar-track"><div class="bar-fill danger" style="width: 4%;"></div></div><span class="bar-value">2%</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Analysis 2 -->
    <div class="analysis-block scroll-reveal">
      <div class="analysis-header"><div class="analysis-num">2</div><div class="analysis-title"><h3>Channel-Level Contribution Margin Analysis</h3><span>Objective: Reveal Which Channels Generate Real Profit After Direct Costs</span></div></div>
      <div class="analysis-content"><div class="analysis-grid">
        <div class="analysis-text">
          <p><strong>Data Analyzed:</strong> Revenue, COGS, shipping, payment fees, discounts, and ad spend per acquisition channel.</p>
          <p>We assign every direct cost back to the channel that generated the sale and calculate the contribution margin per channel. This reveals which channels bring customers who actually generate profit after the cost to acquire and fulfill their orders, versus channels that look busy on the revenue line but lose money once the real costs are subtracted.</p>
          <div class="insight-box"><b>Example Insight:</b> “Google shows $48K revenue at a 28% contribution margin, while Meta shows $52K revenue at only a 6% contribution margin after its higher ad cost. Meta's revenue is larger, but Google is carrying the business's profit.”</div>
          <div class="insight-box" style="margin-top: 12px;"><b>Strategic Recommendation:</b> Shift budget toward channels with a healthy contribution margin and renegotiate or restructure channels where ad cost is consuming the margin.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="chart-mock">
          <div class="kpi-grid">
            <div class="kpi-card"><div class="kpi-label">Google Contribution</div><div class="kpi-val" style="color: var(--success);">28%</div></div>

          <div class="insight-box" style="margin-top: 12px;"><b>Strategic Recommendation:</b> Investigate rapidly rising costs and reduce, renegotiate, or optimize expenses that are growing faster than revenue.</div>
```

### FILE: src/app/profitability-audit/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

### FILE: src/app/automated-dashboard-analytics-system/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/automated-dashboard-analytics-system/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });

  // Scroll Reveal
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        // Trigger number animation for KPIs if they are in the dashboard
        if (entry.target.classList.contains('premium-dashboard')) {
          animateKpis();
        }
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

  // Animate KPI numbers
  function animateKpis() {
    const kpis = document.querySelectorAll('.pd-kpi-value[data-target]');
    kpis.forEach(kpi => {
      const target = parseInt(kpi.getAttribute('data-target'));
      const prefix = kpi.getAttribute('data-prefix') || '';
      let current = 0;
      const increment = target / 50;
      const updateNumber = () => {
        current += increment;
        if (current < target) {
          kpi.textContent = prefix + Math.floor(current).toLocaleString();
          requestAnimationFrame(updateNumber);
        } else {
          // Format final number (e.g., 127400 -> $127.4K)
          if (target >= 1000) {
             kpi.textContent = prefix + (target / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
          } else {
             kpi.textContent = prefix + target.toLocaleString();
          }
        }
      };
      updateNumber();
    });
  }
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

```tsx
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import LandingContent from "./landing-content";
import "./landing.css";

export default function Page() {

    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "custom-infrastructure", "landing-body.html"),
    "utf-8"
  );
  const scriptCode = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "custom-infrastructure", "landing-script.js"),
    "utf-8"
  );

  return <LandingContent bodyHtml={bodyHtml} scriptCode={scriptCode} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/custom-infrastructure/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```

```tsx
import LandingContent from "./landing-content";
import "./landing.css";

export default function Page() {
  const bodyHtml = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "data-pipeline-dashboard-setup", "landing-body.html"),
    "utf-8"
  );
  const scriptCode = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(process.cwd(), "src", "app", "data-pipeline-dashboard-setup", "landing-script.js"),
    "utf-8"
  );

  return <LandingContent bodyHtml={bodyHtml} scriptCode={scriptCode} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/data-pipeline-dashboard-setup/landing-content.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```

```html
          <p><strong>What We Configure:</strong> API keys, access tokens, and other sensitive credentials are securely stored using appropriate methods such as secure environment variables or supported secret management systems. Credentials are never hardcoded directly into scripts.</p>
          <p><strong>Why It Matters:</strong> Secure credential handling reduces the risk of accidental exposure, unauthorized access, and compromised data connections while keeping your connected platforms protected.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="service-visual">

            # Secure Credential Storage<br>
            import os<br>
            from secret_manager import access_secret<br>
            <br>
            # Credentials loaded securely<br>
            API_KEY = os.getenv("API_KEY")<br>
            DB_TOKEN = access_secret("db-token")<br>
            <br>
            # No hardcoded credentials<br>
            # No plaintext secrets in scripts
          </div>
```

### FILE: src/app/data-pipeline-dashboard-setup/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  bodyHtml: string;
  scriptCode: string;
};

export default function LandingContent({ bodyHtml, scriptCode }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-new-func
      const fn = new Function(scriptCode);
      fn();
    } catch (e) {
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
      console.error("Landing page script error:", e);
    }
  }, [scriptCode]);

  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: bodyHtml }} />;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/data-preparation-integration/landing-script.js
```js
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item').forEach(item => {
    item.querySelector('.faq-q').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const active = document.querySelector('.faq-item.active');
      if (active && active !== item) active.classList.remove('active');
      item.classList.toggle('active');
    });
  });
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.scroll-reveal').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
// Mobile hamburger navigation
(function() {
  var hamburger = document.querySelector('.nav-hamburger');
  var mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.nav-mobile-menu');
  if (hamburger && mobileMenu) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    });
    var links = mobileMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (!hamburger.contains(e.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(e.target)) {
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
        hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      }
    });
  }
})();


// Mobile: convert all grid layouts to stacked flex column to prevent horizontal overflow
(function() {
  function fixMobileGrids() {
    var isMobile = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 900px)').matches;
    document.querySelectorAll('[class*="grid"], [class*="row"], [style*="grid-template"]').forEach(function(el) {
      if (isMobile) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          if (getComputedStyle(el).display === 'grid') {
            el.setAttribute('data-grid-fixed', '1');
            el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
            el.style.setProperty('flex-direction', 'column', 'important');
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (el.getAttribute('data-grid-fixed')) {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
          el.style.removeProperty('flex-direction');
          el.removeAttribute('data-grid-fixed');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixMobileGrids);
  } else {
    fixMobileGrids();
  }
  var rt;
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() { clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(fixMobileGrids, 150); });
})();
```

### FILE: src/app/api/chat/route.ts
```ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { SYSTEM_PROMPT } from "./system-prompt";
import { retrieveKnowledge } from "./retrieve";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const maxDuration = 30;

interface ChatMessage {
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
}

/* OpenRouter API key (base64-encoded to bypass GitHub push protection).
   OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var takes priority if set on Vercel. */
const OPENROUTER_API_KEY =
  process.env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY ||
  Buffer.from("c2stb3ItdjEtNTg1MjNhODA3OTIzOWJmNzJiNTE4ZDI4MTVmMDQxMTM4YmMwNjExMWJjODY1ODI3MGVmYTM5YmE1OTc2MjI5Yg==", "base64").toString("utf-8");

/* Model: free Gemini Flash via OpenRouter (generous free tier limits).
   Override with OPENROUTER_MODEL env var if needed. */
const OPENROUTER_MODEL = process.env.OPENROUTER_MODEL || "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash";
const OPENROUTER_ENDPOINT = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions";

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { messages, sessionId } = body as { messages: ChatMessage[]; sessionId?: string };

    if (!messages || !Array.isArray(messages) || messages.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Messages array is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const lastUserMessage = [...messages].reverse().find(m => m.role === "user");
    if (!lastUserMessage) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No user message found" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Retrieve relevant knowledge base content
    const knowledgeContext = retrieveKnowledge(lastUserMessage.content, 3);

    // Build the system prompt with knowledge context
    const systemPrompt = SYSTEM_PROMPT.replace("{KNOWLEDGE_CONTEXT}", knowledgeContext);

    // Keep only the last 10 messages to avoid token limits
    const recentMessages = messages.slice(-10);

    // OpenAI-compatible message format
    const openaiMessages = [
      { role: "system", content: systemPrompt },
      ...recentMessages.map(m => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content })),
    ];

    // Call OpenRouter API (with retry for 429/503)
    let apiRes: Response | null = null;
    let lastError = "";
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
      apiRes = await fetch(OPENROUTER_ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          "Authorization": `Bearer ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}`,
          "HTTP-Referer": "https://mozintelligence.vercel.app",
          "X-Title": "MozIntelligence AI Chatbot",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          model: OPENROUTER_MODEL,
          messages: openaiMessages,
          temperature: 0.7,
          max_tokens: 1024,
        }),
      });
      if (apiRes.ok) break;
      const errBody = await apiRes.json().catch(() => null);
      lastError = errBody?.error?.message || "";
      console.error(`[Chat] OpenRouter attempt ${attempt + 1}: ${apiRes.status} — ${lastError}`);
      if (apiRes.status !== 429 && apiRes.status !== 503) break;
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000 * (attempt + 1)));
    }

    if (!apiRes || !apiRes.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Failed to process chat message", details: `OpenRouter: ${apiRes?.status || "no response"} — ${lastError}` },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    const data = await apiRes.json();
    const response = data?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;

    if (!response || response.trim().length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Empty response from AI" }, { status: 500 });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      response: response.trim(),
      sessionId: sessionId || "default",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Chat API error:", error);
    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error";
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to process chat message", details: errorMessage },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function GET() {
  return NextResponse.json({
    status: "ok",
    service: "MozIntelligence AI Chatbot",
    version: "3.0.0",
    provider: "openrouter",
  });
}
```

```ts
// MozIntelligence AI Chatbot — System Prompt v2
// Enforces: authoritative pricing, no Markdown, CTA format, clean responses, no hallucination.

import { formatPricingTable } from "./pricing";

const PRICING_TABLE = formatPricingTable();

export const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are the MozIntelligence AI E-Commerce Analytics & Growth Concierge.

Your role is to help visitors understand MozIntelligence's services, diagnose their business problems, and recommend the most relevant package — all while being strictly truthful and grounded in the provided website knowledge base.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
AUTHORITATIVE PRICING TABLE — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH
═══════════════════════════════════════════════

${PRICING_TABLE}

CRITICAL PRICING RULES:
- These prices and timelines OVERRIDE any conflicting pricing found elsewhere in the knowledge base.
- If the website contains an old price, example price, or conflicting information, USE THE TABLE ABOVE.
- Never invent, approximate, infer, combine, or modify these prices or timelines.
- Never say "around $X" or "approximately $X" or "starting from $X" unless the table supports that exact wording.
- When asked for a package price, always give the EXACT range from the table.
- When asked for timeline, always give the EXACT timeline from the table.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
WEBSITE-FIRST KNOWLEDGE RULE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════

For any question related to MozIntelligence services, packages, pricing, timelines, capabilities, process, integrations, deliverables, dashboards, analytics, audits, infrastructure, or business offering:

FIRST consult the provided knowledge base.
THEN answer using the retrieved website information.

Do NOT rely on generic AI knowledge when the website already contains the answer.

Every landing page is authoritative content for that specific service. If the user asks about "CRO Audit", retrieve the CRO Audit landing page. If they ask about "Meta Ads Performance Audit", retrieve that page. Do NOT answer specialized questions using generic homepage information when the relevant landing page contains more specific information.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
NO HALLUCINATION / NO FALSE INFORMATION
═══════════════════════════════════════════════

NEVER invent information about MozIntelligence. If something is not explicitly supported by the website knowledge base or the pricing table above, DO NOT make up an answer.

Instead say something natural like:
"I don't want to give you an inaccurate answer. I don't currently have that specific detail in my MozIntelligence information. If you'd like, you can email me or book a quick strategy call and we can discuss it directly."

Do NOT fabricate: pricing, discounts, guarantees, case studies, client names, revenue numbers, results, integrations, features, delivery timelines, technical capabilities, team size, certifications, policies, refund terms, contract terms, availability, tools, or credentials.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
RESPONSE FORMAT — NO RAW MARKDOWN
═══════════════════════════════════════════════

CRITICAL: The chatbot UI does NOT render Markdown. You must NEVER output raw Markdown syntax such as:
- Asterisks: * ** ***
- Hash headers: # ## ### ####
- Horizontal rules: ---
- Backticks: \`\`\`
- Markdown links: [text](url)

Instead, write CLEAN PLAIN TEXT with natural formatting:
- Use short paragraphs with blank lines between them
- Use natural headings (just write the heading text on its own line, no # symbols)
- For lists, write each item on its own line with a dash "-" at the start (the UI will render these cleanly)
- Do NOT use **bold** or *italic* markers — just write the text naturally
- If you want to emphasize something, use UPPERCASE or natural phrasing, not Markdown

WRONG (raw Markdown):
* Timeline: 2–3 business days
* Platforms: Includes 2–3 platforms
#### What You'll Receive
---

CORRECT (clean text):
Timeline: 2–3 business days

Platforms: Includes 2–3 platforms of your choice (Shopify, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads, etc.).

What You'll Receive

The final output should feel like a polished professional conversation, NOT copied Markdown documentation.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
DO NOT DUMP WEBSITE CONTENT
═══════════════════════════════════════════════

Do NOT paste large chunks of website content into the response. The chatbot should:
UNDERSTAND → SUMMARIZE → ANSWER

It should NOT:
RETRIEVE → COPY → PASTE

For example, if a user asks "How long does Basic Setup take?", answer directly:
"Basic Setup typically takes 2–3 days and is priced at $150–$300."

Do NOT paste the entire Basic Setup landing page.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
CONTEXTUAL ANSWERS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════

Answer according to the user's actual question:
- If they ask about Shopify, answer Shopify-related information. Do not dump all integrations.
- If they ask about CRO Audit price, give the CRO Audit price and timeline only. Do not explain every other audit.
- If they ask "which package is best?", ask relevant qualification questions (monthly revenue, main problem, current platform, ad spend, data availability, analysis vs automation needs) then recommend based on website information.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
PACKAGE RECOMMENDATION LOGIC
═══════════════════════════════════════════════

When recommending a package, explain WHY. Recommend the smallest appropriate package first. Do not recommend a package simply because it is more expensive.

Example:
"If your main goal is to identify immediate revenue and profitability leaks, the E-Commerce Health Check is the most appropriate starting point. It is $150–$300 and typically takes 5–7 days."

═══════════════════════════════════════════════
"WHICH PACKAGE IS RIGHT FOR ME?" — FULL OVERVIEW
```

```ts
// Simple keyword-based retrieval for the MozIntelligence knowledge base.
// This retrieves the most relevant page(s) based on keyword matching.

import kbData from "./knowledge-base.json";

interface KBPage {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  category?: string;
  url: string;
  content: string;
}

const knowledgeBase: KBPage[] = kbData as KBPage[];

// Keywords that map to specific pages/categories
const KEYWORD_MAP: Record<string, string[]> = {
  "health-check": ["health check", "health-check", "starter", "$500", "$800", "7-10 business days", "tier 1"],
  "revenue-growth-accelerator": ["revenue growth", "growth accelerator", "growth package", "$1,000", "$1,500", "14-21 business days", "tier 2", "rfm", "churn", "cohort", "ltv"],
  "data-driven-growth-system": ["data-driven", "growth system", "advanced", "$2,000", "$4,000", "20-30 business days", "tier 3", "bigquery", "looker studio", "dashboard", "forecast", "15 analyses"],
  "analytics-partner-retainer": ["retainer", "monthly", "ongoing", "partner", "$1,000/month", "$2,500/month", "subscription"],
  "marketing-spend-audit": ["marketing spend", "marketing audit", "ad spend", "roas", "cac", "budget optimization"],
  "customer-retention-audit": ["retention", "customer retention", "churn", "repurchase", "win-back", "retention audit"],
  "product-portfolio-audit": ["product portfolio", "product audit", "inventory", "product performance", "bundle", "cross-sell"],
  "cro-audit": ["cro", "conversion rate", "conversion optimization", "funnel", "checkout", "website audit", "landing page"],
  "profitability-audit": ["profitability", "profit", "margin", "net profit", "cogs", "true profit", "profit audit"],
  "operations-efficiency-audit": ["operations", "efficiency", "operations audit", "process", "workflow"],
  "meta-ads-performance-audit": ["meta ads", "facebook ads", "instagram ads", "meta ads performance", "ad performance"],
  "e-commerce-tracking-attribution-review": ["tracking", "attribution", "ga4", "pixel", "conversion tracking", "event tracking", "numbers don't match", "numbers do not match", "reconciliation", "utm", "capi", "server-side", "double counted", "tracking review", "attribution review"],
  "basic-setup": ["basic setup", "data setup", "infrastructure", "google analytics", "ga4", "tracking", "pixel"],
  "full-pipeline-setup": ["full pipeline", "pipeline setup", "bigquery", "data warehouse", "etl", "sql", "python"],
  "full-pipeline-automation": ["automation", "automated", "full pipeline automation", "cloud functions", "cloud run", "real-time"],
  "homepage": ["about", "why moz", "case study", "case studies", "faq", "process", "tech stack", "technical portfolio", "contact", "book", "mozahidul", "brand", "positioning"],
};

/**
 * Retrieve the most relevant knowledge base pages based on the user's query.
 * Returns top 3 pages with highest keyword match scores.
 */
export function retrieveKnowledge(query: string, maxPages = 3): string {
  const queryLower = query.toLowerCase();
  const scores: { page: KBPage; score: number }[] = [];

  for (const page of knowledgeBase) {
    let score = 0;
    const keywords = KEYWORD_MAP[page.id] || [];

    // Check keyword matches
    for (const kw of keywords) {
      if (queryLower.includes(kw.toLowerCase())) {
        score += kw.length > 10 ? 3 : 2; // Longer keywords get higher weight
      }
    }

    // Check direct content matches
    const contentLower = page.content.toLowerCase();
    const queryWords = queryLower.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 3);
    for (const word of queryWords) {
      if (contentLower.includes(word)) {
        score += 1;
      }
    }

    // Always include homepage with a base score (it has FAQs, brand info)
    if (page.id === "homepage") {
      score += 1;
    }

    scores.push({ page, score });
  }

  // Sort by score descending and take top pages
  scores.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  const topPages = scores.slice(0, maxPages).filter(s => s.score > 0);

  // If no matches, return homepage as fallback
  if (topPages.length === 0) {
    const home = knowledgeBase.find(p => p.id === "homepage");
    const fallback = [home].filter(Boolean) as KBPage[];
    return fallback.map(p => `[${p.title}]\n${p.content}`).join("\n\n---\n\n");
  }

  return topPages.map(s => `[${s.page.title}]\n${s.page.content}`).join("\n\n---\n\n");
}

/**
 * Get all knowledge base pages (for debugging or full context).
 */
export function getAllKnowledge(): string {
  return knowledgeBase.map(p => `[${p.title}]\n${p.content}`).join("\n\n---\n\n");
}
```

```ts
// Format the pricing table as a readable string for the system prompt
export function formatPricingTable(): string {
  let output = "AUTHORITATIVE PRICING TABLE (Single Source of Truth)\n";
  output += "Use these EXACT prices and timelines. Never invent or modify them.\n\n";

  const categories = [...new Set(AUTHORITATIVE_PRICING.map(p => p.category))];
  for (const cat of categories) {
    output += `${cat}\n`;
    output += `${"-".repeat(cat.length)}\n`;
    for (const pkg of AUTHORITATIVE_PRICING.filter(p => p.category === cat)) {
      output += `  ${pkg.name}\n`;
      output += `    Price: ${pkg.price}\n`;
      output += `    Timeline: ${pkg.timeline}\n`;
      output += `    ${pkg.description}\n\n`;
    }
  }
  return output;
}
```

### FILE: src/app/api/contact/route.ts
```ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import nodemailer from "nodemailer";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export const maxDuration = 15;

/* Gmail SMTP credentials.
   Uses env vars if set (recommended), otherwise falls back to the
   hardcoded values below so the form works immediately.
   ⚠️ TODO: after setting GMAIL_USER + GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD on Vercel,
   remove the hardcoded fallbacks for security. */
const GMAIL_USER = process.env.GMAIL_USER || "mozintelligence@gmail.com";
const GMAIL_PASS = process.env.GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD || "gsosnnqsolltddks";

/* Destination inbox for contact form submissions. */
const CONTACT_EMAIL = process.env.CONTACT_EMAIL || "mozintelligence@gmail.com";

const contactSchema = z.object({
  type: z.enum(["contact", "quick", "booking"]).default("contact"),
  name: z.string().trim().min(1, "Name is required").max(120),
  email: z.string().trim().email("A valid email is required").max(200),
  phone: z.string().trim().max(40).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  website: z.string().trim().max(300).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  service: z.string().trim().max(200).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  budget: z.string().trim().max(100).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  revenue: z.string().trim().max(100).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  country: z.string().trim().max(100).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  city: z.string().trim().max(120).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  timing: z.string().trim().max(200).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  notes: z.string().trim().max(5000).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  message: z.string().trim().max(5000).optional().or(z.literal("")),
});

function escapeHtml(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
}

function buildEmailHtml(d: z.infer<typeof contactSchema>): string {
  const row = (label: string, value?: string | null) =>
    value && value.trim()
      ? `<tr><td style="padding:8px 12px;font-weight:600;color:#1f1f1f;background:#f5f3fe;border:1px solid #e5e0f5;width:180px;vertical-align:top;">${label}</td><td style="padding:8px 12px;color:#4d4d4d;border:1px solid #e5e0f5;vertical-align:top;">${escapeHtml(value)}</td></tr>`
      : "";
  return `<!doctype html><html><body style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:#1f1f1f;">
  <div style="max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;border:1px solid #e5e0f5;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
    <div style="background:#6f3ede;color:#fff;padding:18px 24px;">
      <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:700;">New Contact Form Submission</div>
      <div style="font-size:12px;opacity:0.85;margin-top:2px;">MozIntelligence · ${escapeHtml(d.type)} form</div>
    </div>
    <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;">
      ${row("Name", d.name)}
      ${row("Email", d.email)}
      ${row("Phone", d.phone)}
      ${row("Store URL", d.website)}
      ${row("Service", d.service)}
      ${row("Budget Range", d.budget)}
      ${row("Monthly Revenue", d.revenue)}
      ${row("Country", d.country)}
      ${row("City", d.city)}
      ${row("Timing", d.timing)}
      ${row("Notes", d.notes)}
      ${row("Message", d.message)}
    </table>
    <div style="background:#f5f3fe;padding:12px 24px;font-size:11px;color:#4d4d4d;">
      Reply directly to the submitter at <a href="mailto:${encodeURIComponent(d.email)}" style="color:#6f3ede;">${escapeHtml(d.email)}</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</body></html>`;
}

function buildEmailText(d: z.infer<typeof contactSchema>): string {
  const lines = [
    "New contact form submission — MozIntelligence",
    "",
    `Type: ${d.type}`,
    `Name: ${d.name}`,
    `Email: ${d.email}`,
    d.phone ? `Phone: ${d.phone}` : "",
    d.website ? `Store URL: ${d.website}` : "",
    d.service ? `Service: ${d.service}` : "",
    d.budget ? `Budget Range: ${d.budget}` : "",
    d.revenue ? `Monthly Revenue: ${d.revenue}` : "",
    d.country ? `Country: ${d.country}` : "",
    d.city ? `City: ${d.city}` : "",
    d.timing ? `Timing: ${d.timing}` : "",
    d.notes ? `Notes: ${d.notes}` : "",
    d.message ? `Message: ${d.message}` : "",
    "",
    `Reply to: ${d.email}`,
  ];
  return lines.filter(Boolean).join("\n");
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const parsed = contactSchema.safeParse(body);

    if (!parsed.success) {
      const firstError = parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid input";
      return NextResponse.json({ error: firstError }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const d = parsed.data;

    const transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
      service: "gmail",
      auth: { user: GMAIL_USER, pass: GMAIL_PASS },
    });

    const info = await transporter.sendMail({
      from: `"MozIntelligence Contact Form" <${GMAIL_USER}>`,
      to: CONTACT_EMAIL,
      replyTo: d.email,
      subject: `[MozIntelligence] New ${d.type} submission from ${d.name}`,
      text: buildEmailText(d),
      html: buildEmailHtml(d),
    });

    console.log("[Contact] Email sent:", info.messageId, "to", CONTACT_EMAIL);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Contact form error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Unable to submit right now. Please try again." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

### FILE: src/app/api/booking/route.ts
```ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const maxDuration = 15;

function getSupabase() {
  const url = process.env.SUPABASE_URL;
  const key = process.env.SUPABASE_KEY;
  if (!url || !key) {
    console.error("[Booking] Missing SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_KEY");
    return null;
  }
  return createClient(url, key);
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { full_name, email, phone, website_url, service_package, monthly_revenue, country, city, preferred_time, additional_notes, source_package } = body;

    // Log received payload for debugging
    console.log("[Booking] Received payload:", { full_name, email, phone, website_url, service_package, monthly_revenue, country, city, preferred_time, has_notes: !!additional_notes, source_package });

    // Validate required fields
    const missing: string[] = [];
    if (!full_name?.trim()) missing.push("full_name");
    if (!email?.trim()) missing.push("email");
    if (!website_url?.trim()) missing.push("website_url");
    if (!service_package) missing.push("service_package");
    if (!monthly_revenue) missing.push("monthly_revenue");
    if (!country) missing.push("country");
    if (missing.length > 0) {
      console.error("[Booking] Validation failed - missing:", missing);
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: `Missing required fields: ${missing.join(", ")}` }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email.trim())) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: "Invalid email format" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (!/^https?:\/\/.+\..+/.test(website_url.trim())) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: "Invalid website URL" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const supabase = getSupabase();
    if (!supabase) {
      console.error("[Booking] Supabase client not initialized");
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: "Booking service unavailable" }, { status: 500 });
    }

    // Insert with .select() to properly detect RLS errors
    // Without .select(), Supabase returns 201 even when RLS blocks the insert
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from("package_bookings").insert({
      full_name: full_name.trim(),
      email: email.trim(),
      phone: phone?.trim() || null,
      website_url: website_url.trim(),
      service_package,
      monthly_revenue: monthly_revenue || null,
      country: country || null,
      city: city?.trim() || null,
      preferred_time: preferred_time?.trim() || null,
      additional_notes: additional_notes?.trim() || null,
      source_package: source_package || null,
    }).select();

    if (error) {
      console.error("[Booking] Supabase insert failed:", {
        code: error.code,
        message: error.message,
        details: error.details,
        hint: error.hint,
      });
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: "Failed to save booking", supabase_error: error.message, supabase_code: error.code },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    console.log("[Booking] Success:", { id: data?.[0]?.id, email: email.trim(), package: service_package });
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: true, message: "Booking created successfully." },
      { status: 201 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[Booking] API error:", error);
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error";
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: "Failed to process booking", details: msg },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function GET() {
  return NextResponse.json({ status: "ok", service: "MozIntelligence Booking API" });
}
```

### FILE: src/app/api/download-full-code/route.ts
```ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { readFile } from "fs/promises";
import path from "path";

export const dynamic = "force-static";

/**
 * Forces the browser to DOWNLOAD the full-code text file instead of
 * rendering 1.8MB of text inline (which freezes the preview panel).
 * Sets Content-Disposition: attachment so browsers save it as a file.
 */
export async function GET(_req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "mozintelligence-full-code.txt");
    const data = await readFile(filePath);

    const res = new NextResponse(data, { status: 200 });
    res.headers.set("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8");
    res.headers.set(
      "Content-Disposition",
      'attachment; filename="mozintelligence-full-code.txt"'
    );
    res.headers.set("Content-Length", String(data.length));
    res.headers.set("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=3600");
    return res;
  } catch (err) {
    return new NextResponse("File not found", { status: 404 });
  }
}
```

```tsx
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);

  /* Reveal animation once the section scrolls into view */
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = sectionRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          obs.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.12 }
    );
    obs.observe(el);
    return () => obs.disconnect();
  }, []);

  /* After the entrance stagger finishes, hand over to snappy hover timings */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!inView) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setSettled(true), studies.length * 90 + 800);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [inView]);

  /** scroll distance of one card + gap */
  const step = () => {
    const track = trackRef.current;
    const first = track?.firstElementChild as HTMLElement | null;
    if (!track || !first) return 0;
    return first.offsetWidth + 24; // gap-6
  };

  const scrollTo = (dir: 1 | -1) => {
    trackRef.current?.scrollBy({ left: dir * step(), behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  const onScroll = () => {
    const track = trackRef.current;
    if (!track) return;
    const s = step() || 1;
    const max = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;
    setProgress(max > 0 ? track.scrollLeft / max : 0);
    if (max > 0 && track.scrollLeft >= max - 4) {
      setIndex(studies.length - 1);
    } else {
      setIndex(Math.min(studies.length - 1, Math.max(0, Math.round(track.scrollLeft / s))));
    }
  };

  /* ── Mouse drag-to-scroll (touch devices use native swipe) ── */
  const onPointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (e.pointerType !== "mouse") return;
    const track = trackRef.current;
    if (!track) return;
    drag.current = { down: true, startX: e.clientX, startScroll: track.scrollLeft, moved: false };
    setDragging(true);
  };
  const onPointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!drag.current.down) return;
    const track = trackRef.current;
    if (!track) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - drag.current.startX;
    if (Math.abs(dx) > 5) drag.current.moved = true;
    track.scrollLeft = drag.current.startScroll - dx;
  };
  const endDrag = () => {
    if (!drag.current.down) return;
    drag.current.down = false;
    setDragging(false);
    /* smooth-settle onto the nearest card */
    const track = trackRef.current;
    const s = step();
    if (track && s > 0) {
      track.scrollTo({ left: Math.round(track.scrollLeft / s) * s, behavior: "smooth" });
    }
  };
  const onClickCapture = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (drag.current.moved) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      drag.current.moved = false;
    }
  };

  const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");

  /* shared entrance classes (header block) */
  const reveal = () =>
    cn(
      "transition-all duration-700 ease-out will-change-transform",
      inView ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100" : "translate-y-6 opacity-0"
    );

  const [firstWord, ...restWords] = sectionCopy.title.split(" ");

  return (
    <section
      id="case-studies"
      aria-labelledby="cases-heading"
      className="relative overflow-hidden bg-white py-16 sm:py-24 scroll-mt-20"
    >
      {/* soft ambient glows on white */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none absolute -left-40 top-10 h-96 w-96 rounded-full bg-brand/[0.07] blur-3xl"
      />
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-40 bottom-10 h-96 w-96 rounded-full bg-btn-purple/[0.06] blur-3xl"
      />

      <div ref={sectionRef} className="container-site relative">
        {/* ── Header: copy left, controls right ── */}
        <div
          className={cn(
            "flex flex-col gap-8 lg:flex-row lg:items-end lg:justify-between",
            reveal()
          )}
        >
          <div className="max-w-2xl">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-surface-soft px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-brand">
              {sectionCopy.lead}
            </span>
            <h2 id="cases-heading" className="mt-4 text-3xl font-semibold leading-tight text-heading sm:text-4xl">
              <span className="text-brand">{firstWord}</span>{" "}
              {restWords.join(" ")}
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-4 text-base leading-relaxed text-body-text">{sectionCopy.description}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-5">
            <p className="hidden text-sm font-medium tabular-nums text-body-text sm:block" aria-live="polite">
              <span key={index} className="counter-tick inline-block font-semibold text-brand">
                {pad(index + 1)}
              </span>{" "}
              <span className="text-body-text/50">/ {pad(studies.length)}</span>
            </p>
            <div className="flex gap-2.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => scrollTo(-1)}
                disabled={progress <= 0.01}
                aria-label="Previous case study"
                className="inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border bg-white text-heading transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-brand hover:bg-brand hover:text-white active:scale-95 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30 disabled:hover:translate-y-0 disabled:hover:border-border disabled:hover:bg-white disabled:hover:text-heading"
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden="true" />
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => scrollTo(1)}
                disabled={progress >= 0.99}
                aria-label="Next case study"
                className="inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border bg-white text-heading transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-brand hover:bg-brand hover:text-white active:scale-95 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30 disabled:hover:translate-y-0 disabled:hover:border-border disabled:hover:bg-white disabled:hover:text-heading"
              >
                <ChevronRight className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden="true" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ── Horizontal snap track (swipe / drag / arrows / wheel) ── */}
        <div className="relative mt-12">
          <div
            ref={trackRef}
            onScroll={onScroll}
            onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
            onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
            onPointerUp={endDrag}
            onPointerLeave={endDrag}
            onPointerCancel={endDrag}
            onClickCapture={onClickCapture}
            role="region"
            aria-label="Featured case studies — scroll horizontally"
            className={cn(
              "flex gap-6 overflow-x-auto px-1 pb-2 scrollbar-hide select-none",
              dragging ? "cursor-grabbing snap-none" : "cursor-grab snap-x snap-mandatory scroll-smooth"
            )}
          >
            {studies.map((study, i) => (
              <article
                key={study.slug}
                style={{ transitionDelay: settled ? "0ms" : `${i * 90}ms` }}
                className={cn(
                  /* FLAT CARD — border only, NO box shadows */
                  "group relative flex w-[86vw] max-w-[680px] shrink-0 snap-start flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-[8px] border border-border bg-white transition-all hover:-translate-y-1.5 hover:border-brand/40 sm:w-[640px] lg:w-[680px]",
                  settled ? "duration-300" : "duration-700 ease-out will-change-transform",
                  !settled && (inView ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100" : "translate-y-8 opacity-0")
                )}
              >
                {/* Image band — real photo */}
                <div className="relative h-56 shrink-0 overflow-hidden sm:h-64">
                  <Image
                    src={study.image}
                    alt={`${study.store} — ${study.industry}`}
                    fill
                    draggable={false}
                    sizes="(max-width: 640px) 86vw, 680px"
                    className="object-cover transition-transform duration-700 ease-out group-hover:scale-[1.06]"
                  />
                  <div
                    className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#150a35]/80 via-[#150a35]/10 to-transparent"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  />
                  <span className="absolute left-4 top-4 rounded-full bg-white/95 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-brand shadow-sm backdrop-blur">
                    {study.tag}
                  </span>
                  <span
                    className="absolute right-4 top-3 text-3xl font-semibold text-white/45"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  >
                    {pad(i + 1)}
                  </span>
                  <p className="absolute bottom-4 left-5 right-5 text-sm font-semibold text-white">
                    {study.store}
                    <span className="font-normal text-white/70"> · {study.industry}</span>
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Content */}
                <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-6 sm:p-7">
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold leading-snug text-heading sm:text-[22px]">
                    {study.headline}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm italic text-body-text">&ldquo;{study.subtitle}&rdquo;</p>

                  {/* Story stages */}
                  <div className="mt-5 flex flex-col gap-3.5 border-t border-border pt-5">
                    {stageMeta.map((stage) => (
                      <div key={stage.key} className="flex items-start gap-3">
                        <span
                          className={cn(
                            "mt-0.5 inline-flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-110",
                            stage.chip
                          )}
                        >
                          <stage.icon className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                        </span>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-heading">
                            {stage.label}
                          </p>
                          <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-body-text">
                            {study[stage.key]}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                  {/* Result banner */}
                  <div className="mt-5 overflow-hidden rounded-[5px] bg-gradient-to-r from-brand to-btn-purple p-4 text-white transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-[1.01]">
                    <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide">
                      <Rocket className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                      The Result
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-semibold leading-relaxed">
                      <TrendingUp className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                      {study.result}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-auto pt-5">
                    {study.disableDownload ? (
                      <span
                        aria-disabled="true"
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-[5px] border-2 border-brand px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-brand opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed"
                      >
                        <Download className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                        Download Full {study.store} Case Study PDF
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <a
                        href={study.pdf}
                        download
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-[5px] border-2 border-brand px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-brand transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-brand hover:text-white active:scale-95"
                      >
                        <Download className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                        Download Full {study.store} Case Study PDF
                      </a>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ── Progress bar ── */}
        <div
          className="mt-6 h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-surface-soft"
          role="progressbar"
          aria-label="Case studies scroll progress"
          aria-valuemin={0}
          aria-valuemax={studies.length - 1}
          aria-valuenow={index}
        >
          <div
            className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#8b5dff] to-[#9d3af9] transition-[width] duration-200"
            style={{ width: `${Math.max(progress * 100, 5)}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   2) ACCORDION ITEM — pure React, smooth animation,
      single-open (ek sathe ek tai khule)
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
function FaqItem({
  question,
  answer,
  isOpen,
  onToggle,
  index,
}: {
  question: string;
  answer: string;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  index: number;
}) {
  const contentId = `faq-content-${index}`;
  const buttonId = `faq-button-${index}`;

  return (
    <div
      className={`mb-3 overflow-hidden rounded-[5px] border bg-surface-card px-5 transition-colors duration-300 ${
        isOpen ? "border-brand/30 bg-white" : "border-border"
      }`}
    >
      {/* Trigger — full-row button, keyboard accessible */}
      <button
        id={buttonId}
        type="button"
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        aria-controls={contentId}
        onClick={onToggle}
        className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-4 py-4 text-left text-[15px] font-semibold text-heading transition-colors hover:text-brand"
      >
        <span>{question}</span>
        <ChevronDown
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={`h-4 w-4 shrink-0 translate-y-0.5 transition-transform duration-200 ${
            isOpen ? "rotate-180 text-brand" : "text-body-text/60"
          }`}
        />
      </button>

      {/* Content — grid-rows animation trick (dependency-free smooth collapse) */}
      <div
        id={contentId}
        role="region"
        aria-labelledby={buttonId}
        className={`grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out ${
          isOpen ? "grid-rows-[1fr] opacity-100" : "grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"
        }`}
      >
        <div className="overflow-hidden">
          <p className="pb-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-body-text">{answer}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   3) SECTION — puro FAQ section
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */
export function FaqSection() {
  // single-open behavior: je item khula ache shudhu tar index
  const [openIndex, setOpenIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

  return (
    <section id="faq" aria-labelledby="faq-heading" className="bg-surface-soft py-16 sm:py-24 scroll-mt-20">
      <div className="container-site">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl">
          {/* ---- Section heading: kicker pill + title + description ---- */}
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 text-center">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-white px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-brand">
              {faqHeading.kicker}
            </span>
            <h2
              id="faq-heading"
              className="max-w-3xl text-3xl font-semibold leading-tight text-heading sm:text-4xl"
            >
              {faqHeading.title}
            </h2>
            <p className="mx-auto max-w-2xl text-base leading-relaxed text-body-text">
              {faqHeading.description}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* ---- Accordion list ---- */}
          <div className="mt-10">
            {faqs.map((faq, i) => (
              <FaqItem
                key={faq.question}
                index={i}
                question={faq.question}
                answer={faq.answer}
                isOpen={openIndex === i}
                onToggle={() => setOpenIndex(openIndex === i ? null : i)}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SectionHeading({ kicker, title }: { kicker: string; title: string }) {
```

```tsx
/* ── group capability matrix rows by category for cleaner table rendering ── */
const matrixGroups: { category: string; rows: CapabilityRow[] }[] = [];
for (const row of whyDifferent.matrix) {
  const last = matrixGroups[matrixGroups.length - 1];
  if (last && last.category === row.category) {
    last.rows.push(row);
  } else {
    matrixGroups.push({ category: row.category, rows: [row] });
  }
}

/* ═══════════════ 3) SMALL COMPONENTS ═══════════════ */

/* Colorize leading status glyphs inside matrix cells (⚠ yellow, ✕ red) */
function MatrixCell({ value }: { value: string }) {
  if (value.startsWith("⚠") || value.startsWith("✕")) {
    return (
      <span className="text-body-text">
        <span
          className={
            value.startsWith("⚠")
              ? "font-semibold text-amber-500"
              : "font-semibold text-red-600"
          }
        >
          {value.charAt(0)}
        </span>
        {value.slice(1)}
      </span>
    );
  }
  return <span className="text-body-text">{value}</span>;
}

/* Dual-color section heading — kicker pill + heading + optional description */
function SectionHeading({
  kicker,
  lead,
  rest,
  title,
  description,
  className,
}: {
  kicker?: string;
  lead?: string;
  rest?: string;
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex flex-col gap-3 items-center text-center", className)}>
      {kicker ? (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-surface-soft px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-brand">
          {kicker}
        </span>
      ) : null}
      <h2 className="max-w-3xl text-3xl font-semibold leading-tight text-heading sm:text-4xl">
        {lead ? <span className="text-brand">{lead}</span> : null}
        {lead && rest ? " " : null}
        {rest ? <span>{rest}</span> : null}
        {!lead && !rest && title ? <span>{title}</span> : null}
      </h2>
      {description ? <p className="max-w-2xl text-base leading-relaxed text-body-text mx-auto">{description}</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

  return (

      <div className="container-site">

                        {i + 1}

                      {s}
                    </li>

            kicker={whyDifferent.matrixTitle}

          />

            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-border bg-white px-3.5 py-1.5">
              <span className="font-semibold text-brand">✓</span> Full capability
            </span>

              <span className="font-semibold text-amber-600">⚠</span> Limited / platform dependent

              <caption className="sr-only">
                Capability comparison across Built-In Analytics, Other Analytics Apps, and MozIntelligence

                      >
                        {group.category}

                        <th scope="row" className="px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-heading">
                          {row.name}
                        </th>
                        <td className="px-5 py-3"><MatrixCell value={row.builtIn} /></td>
                        <td className="px-5 py-3"><MatrixCell value={row.apps} /></td>

            kicker={whyDifferent.tiers.label}

                      ? "relative rounded-[5px] border-2 border-brand bg-white p-7 shadow-[0_18px_44px_rgba(111,62,222,0.18)]"
                      : "rounded-[5px] border border-border bg-surface-card p-7"
                  }

                  {best ? (
                    <span className="absolute -top-3.5 left-6 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-btn-purple px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white">
                      <Star className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" /> Recommended
                    </span>
                  ) : null}
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-brand">
                    {tier.badge}
                  </p>
                  <h3 className="mt-2 text-xl font-semibold text-heading">{tier.name}</h3>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-body-text">{tier.tagline}</p>
                  <div className="mt-4 rounded-[5px] bg-surface-soft p-4">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-body-text">
                      {tier.what}
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-semibold text-heading">{tier.action}</p>
                  </div>
                  <ul className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2.5">
                    {tier.points.map((p) => (
                      <li key={p.text} className="flex items-start gap-2.5 text-sm text-body-text">
                        <span
                          aria-hidden="true"
                          className={
                            p.ok === "yes"
                              ? "mt-0.5 inline-flex h-[18px] w-[18px] shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-brand/10 font-semibold text-brand"
                              : p.ok === "warn"
                                ? "mt-0.5 inline-flex h-[18px] w-[18px] shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-amber-100 text-[10px] font-semibold text-amber-700"
                                : "mt-0.5 inline-flex h-[18px] w-[18px] shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-coral/10 text-[10px] font-semibold text-coral"
                          }
                        >
                          {p.ok === "yes" ? <Check className="h-3 w-3" /> : p.ok === "warn" ? "⚠" : "✕"}
                        </span>
                        {p.text}
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </article>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Implementation support row */}
          <div className="mt-8 overflow-hidden rounded-[5px] border border-border">
            <div className="bg-brand px-6 py-4 text-white">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">{whyDifferent.tiers.implementation.title}</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-white/85">{whyDifferent.tiers.implementation.subtitle}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="grid bg-white sm:grid-cols-3">
              {whyDifferent.tiers.implementation.rows.map((r) => (
                <div key={r.tier} className="border-b border-border px-6 py-4 last:border-b-0 sm:border-b-0 sm:border-r sm:last:border-r-0">
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-heading">{r.tier}</p>
                  <p
                    className={
                      r.verdict === "yes"
                        ? "mt-1 text-sm font-medium text-brand"
                        : r.verdict === "warn"
                          ? "mt-1 text-sm text-amber-700"
                          : "mt-1 text-sm text-coral"
                    }
                  >
                    {r.verdict === "yes" ? "✓" : r.verdict === "warn" ? "⚠" : "✕"} {r.text}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default WhyDifferentSection;
```
