### FILE: src/components/chatbot-widget.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Bot, Calendar, Mail, MessageCircle, Send, X } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface ChatMessage {
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
}

const QUICK_QUESTIONS = [
  "What services do you offer?",
  "How much does the Health Check cost?",
  "Do you work with Shopify?",
  "Which package is right for me?",
];

const GREETING: ChatMessage = {
  role: "assistant",
  content:
    "Hi! I'm the MozIntelligence AI Concierge. I can help you understand our e-commerce analytics services, find the right package for your store, and answer questions about pricing, deliverables, and integrations.\n\nWhat brings you here today?",
};

// CTA destinations — same links the previous widget used (Contact section).
const BOOKING_URL = "https://calendar.app.google/TGnzfC65zBF3hVeD9";
const EMAIL_URL =
  "https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to=mojahidulislam101010@gmail.com&su=Discovery+Call+Inquiry&body=Hi+Mozahidul%2C+I+visited+your+portfolio+and+want+to+discuss+my+e-commerce+data+needs.";

// Fallback CTA appended to error messages so users can ALWAYS reach you
// even if the backend is temporarily unavailable.
const ERROR_CTA_BLOCK =
  "[CTA]\nintro: I couldn't reach the live AI just now — but I can still help you directly. Book a free 20-minute strategy call and we'll go through your questions together.\nbook_label: Book a Free 20-Min Strategy Call\nemail_label: Email Me\n[/CTA]";

interface CTABlock {
  intro: string;
  bookLabel: string;
  emailLabel: string;
}

/**
 * The backend's system prompt appends a `[CTA]...[/CTA]` block to every
 * assistant response (intro + book_label + email_label). We parse it into
 * Book/Email buttons that render at the end of each assistant message —
 * matching the behaviour of the previous widget.
 */
function parseCTA(content: string): { text: string; cta: CTABlock | null } {
  const ctaMatch = content.match(/\[CTA\]([\s\S]*?)\[\/CTA\]/);
  if (!ctaMatch) {
    return { text: content.trim(), cta: null };
  }

  const ctaContent = ctaMatch[1];
  const text = content.replace(/\[CTA\][\s\S]*?\[\/CTA\]/, "").trim();

  const introMatch = ctaContent.match(/intro:\s*(.+)/);
  const bookMatch = ctaContent.match(/book_label:\s*(.+)/);
  const emailMatch = ctaContent.match(/email_label:\s*(.+)/);

  return {
    text,
    cta: {
      intro: introMatch ? introMatch[1].trim() : "",
      bookLabel: bookMatch ? bookMatch[1].trim() : "Book a Free 20-Min Strategy Call",
      emailLabel: emailMatch ? emailMatch[1].trim() : "Email Me",
    },
  };
}

/**
 * MozIntelligence AI Concierge — floating chat widget answering questions
 * grounded in the site's real package/pricing data (via /api/chat).
 */
export function ChatWidget() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([GREETING]);
  const [input, setInput] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showIntro, setShowIntro] = useState(true);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scrollRef.current) {
      scrollRef.current.scrollTop = scrollRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [messages, open]);

  async function send(text: string) {
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    if (!trimmed || loading) return;

    const nextMessages: ChatMessage[] = [...messages, { role: "user", content: trimmed }];
    setMessages(nextMessages);
    setInput("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/chat", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          messages: nextMessages
            .filter((m) => m !== GREETING || nextMessages.length === 1)
            .map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content })),
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Request failed");
      // Reads `reply` (new shape) with fallback to `response` (existing backend shape)
      const body = (await res.json()) as { reply?: string; response?: string };
      const replyText =
        body.reply ||
        body.response ||
        "";
      // If backend gave an answer, use it. Otherwise show error + always-CTA.
      setMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          content: replyText
            ? replyText
            : `Sorry — I couldn't reach the live AI just now. Please try again, or book a free 20-minute discovery call and we'll answer you directly.\n\n${ERROR_CTA_BLOCK}`,
        },
      ]);
    } catch {
      setMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          content: `Sorry — something went wrong on my side. Please try again, or book a free 20-minute discovery call and we'll answer you directly.\n\n${ERROR_CTA_BLOCK}`,
        },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      {/* Floating action button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          setOpen((v) => !v);
          setShowIntro(false);
        }}
        aria-label={open ? "Close the MozIntelligence AI chat" : "Chat with the MozIntelligence AI Concierge"}
        aria-expanded={open}
        className="fixed bottom-[96px] right-5 lg:bottom-5 z-[60] inline-flex h-14 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-btn-purple px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-[0_10px_28px_rgba(157,58,249,0.45)] transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-btn-purple-hover focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-btn-purple/60 focus-visible:ring-offset-2"
      >
        {open ? <X className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden="true" /> : <MessageCircle className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden="true" />}
        <span className="hidden sm:inline">{open ? "Close" : "Chat with us"}</span>
      </button>

      {/* Teaser bubble */}
      {!open && showIntro ? (
        <div className="fixed bottom-[172px] right-5 lg:bottom-24 z-[60] max-w-[180px] lg:max-w-[240px] rounded-[5px] border border-border bg-white p-2.5 lg:p-4 shadow-[0_14px_36px_rgba(31,31,31,0.16)]">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowIntro(false)}
            aria-label="Dismiss message"
            className="absolute -right-2 -top-2 inline-flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white text-body-text shadow-sm transition-colors hover:text-heading"
          >
            <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>
          <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5 lg:gap-2 text-[10px] lg:text-sm font-semibold text-brand">
            <MessageCircle className="h-3 w-3 lg:h-4 lg:w-4" aria-hidden="true" /> Find where your profit is leaking!
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* Chat panel */}
      <div
        className={cn(
          "fixed bottom-[172px] right-5 lg:bottom-24 z-[60] flex w-[calc(100vw-2.5rem)] max-w-sm origin-bottom-right flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-[5px] border border-border bg-white shadow-[0_18px_48px_rgba(31,31,31,0.22)] transition-all duration-200",
          open ? "pointer-events-auto scale-100 opacity-100" : "pointer-events-none scale-95 opacity-0"
        )}
        role="dialog"
        aria-label="MozIntelligence AI Concierge"
        aria-hidden={!open}
      >
        {/* Header — dark purple so white text reads clearly (no token dependency) */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-[#2e1065] px-5 py-4 text-white">
          <span className="inline-flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/15">
            <Bot className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden="true" />
          </span>
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold">MozIntelligence AI</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-white/80">E-Commerce Analytics Concierge</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Messages */}
        <div ref={scrollRef} className="max-h-80 flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-4 scrollbar-slim">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            {messages.map((m, i) => {
              const { text, cta } =
                m.role === "assistant" ? parseCTA(m.content) : { text: m.content, cta: null };
              return (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  className={cn(
                    "max-w-[85%] whitespace-pre-line rounded-[5px] px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm leading-relaxed",
                    m.role === "assistant"
                      ? "self-start bg-surface-soft text-heading"
                      : "self-end bg-btn-purple text-white"
                  )}
                >
                  {text}
                  {cta ? (
                    <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 border-t border-border/60 pt-3">
                      {cta.intro ? (
                        <p className="mb-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-body-text">{cta.intro}</p>
                      ) : null}
                      <a
                        href={BOOKING_URL}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-[5px] bg-btn-purple px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:bg-btn-purple-hover"
                      >
                        <Calendar className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                        {cta.bookLabel}
                      </a>
                      <a
                        href={EMAIL_URL}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-[5px] border border-brand/40 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-brand transition-colors hover:bg-surface-soft"
                      >
                        <Mail className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
                        {cta.emailLabel}
                      </a>
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              );
            })}
            {loading ? (
              <div className="self-start rounded-[5px] bg-surface-soft px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-body-text" aria-live="polite">
                Typing…
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          {/* Quick questions — shown until the user replies */}
          {messages.length === 1 && !loading ? (
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-body-text/70">
                Quick questions:
              </p>
              {QUICK_QUESTIONS.map((q) => (
                <button
                  key={q}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => send(q)}
                  className="rounded-[5px] border border-border bg-white px-3.5 py-2 text-left text-sm text-heading transition-colors hover:border-brand/40 hover:bg-surface-soft hover:text-brand"
                >
                  {q}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        {/* Composer */}
        <form
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            send(input);
          }}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-border px-3 py-3"
        >
          <label htmlFor="chat-input" className="sr-only">
            Type your question
          </label>
          <input
            id="chat-input"
            type="text"
            value={input}
            onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Ask about packages, pricing…"
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-[5px] border border-input bg-white px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-heading placeholder:text-body-text/50 focus:border-brand focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand/25"
          />
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading || !input.trim()}
            aria-label="Send message"
            className="inline-flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[5px] bg-btn-purple text-white transition-colors hover:bg-btn-purple-hover disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <Send className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>
        </form>
        <p className="border-t border-border px-4 py-2 text-center text-[10px] text-body-text/70">
          Powered by MozIntelligence AI · Grounded in website data
        </p>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

// Backward-compatible export so the existing import in src/app/page.tsx
// (`import { ChatbotWidget } from '@/components/chatbot-widget'`) keeps working
```

### FILE: src/components/booking-modal.tsx
```tsx
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { X, Loader2, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

interface BookingModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  defaultPackage?: string;
}

// All service packages organized by category
const SERVICE_PACKAGES = [
  { label: '─ Part 1: Core E-Commerce Packages ─', options: [
    'E-Commerce Health Check',
    'Revenue Growth Accelerator',
    'Data-Driven Growth System',
    'Analytics Partner Retainer',
  ]},
  { label: '─ Part 2: Specialized Add-On Packages ─', options: [
    'Marketing Spend Audit',
    'Customer Retention Audit',
    'Product Portfolio Audit',
    'CRO/Website Audit',
    'Profitability Audit',
    'Operations Efficiency Audit',
    'Meta Ads Performance Audit',
  ]},
  { label: '─ Part 3: Data Setup & Infrastructure ─', options: [
    'Basic Setup',
    'Full Pipeline Setup',
    'Full Pipeline + Automation',
  ]},
  { label: '─ Other ─', options: [
    'Custom Analytics Setup',
    'Not sure yet (Need advice)',
  ]},
];

const REVENUE_RANGES = [
  'Below $1k / Mo',
  '$1k – $10k / Mo',
  '$10k – $20k / Mo',
  '$20k – $40k / Mo',
  '$40k – $60k / Mo',
  '$60k – $100k / Mo',
  '$100k+ / Mo',
];

interface FormData {
  full_name: string;
  email: string;
  phone_whatsapp: string;
  website_url: string;
  service_package: string;
  monthly_revenue: string;
  preferred_call_time: string;
  additional_notes: string;
}

interface FormErrors {
  [key: string]: string;
}

const INITIAL_FORM: FormData = {
  full_name: '',
  email: '',
  phone_whatsapp: '',
  website_url: '',
  service_package: '',
  monthly_revenue: '',
  preferred_call_time: '',
  additional_notes: '',
};

export function BookingModal({ isOpen, onClose, defaultPackage }: BookingModalProps) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<FormData>(INITIAL_FORM);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<FormErrors>({});
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [submitStatus, setSubmitStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');
  const modalRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const firstInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Set default package when modal opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && defaultPackage) {
      setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, service_package: defaultPackage }));
      setSubmitStatus('idle');
      setErrors({});
    }
  }, [isOpen, defaultPackage]);

  // Focus first input when modal opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setTimeout(() => firstInputRef.current?.focus(), 200);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Handle ESC key
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleEsc = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && !isSubmitting) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
    // Prevent body scroll
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEsc);
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, [isOpen, onClose, isSubmitting]);

  // Handle backdrop click
  const handleBackdropClick = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !isSubmitting) {
      onClose();
    }
  }, [onClose, isSubmitting]);

  // Validate form
  const validate = (): boolean => {
    const newErrors: FormErrors = {};

    if (!formData.full_name.trim()) {
      newErrors.full_name = 'Full name is required';
    }

    if (!formData.email.trim()) {
      newErrors.email = 'Email is required';
    } else if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(formData.email.trim())) {
      newErrors.email = 'Please enter a valid email address';
    }

    if (!formData.website_url.trim()) {
      newErrors.website_url = 'Website URL is required';
    } else if (!/^https?:\/\/.+\..+/.test(formData.website_url.trim())) {
      newErrors.website_url = 'Please enter a valid URL (e.g., https://yourstore.com)';
    }

    if (!formData.service_package) {
      newErrors.service_package = 'Please select a service package';
    }

    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  // Handle input change
  const handleChange = (field: keyof FormData, value: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
    // Clear error when user types
    if (errors[field]) {
      setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: '' }));
    }
  };

  // Submit form
  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (isSubmitting) return;

    if (!validate()) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setSubmitStatus('idle');

    try {
      const response = await fetch('https://preview-chat-896fc7f7-9316-4e75-a15e-cb944bad21fe.space-z.ai/api/booking?XTransformPort=3003', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...formData,
          source_package: defaultPackage || 'Marketing Spend Audit',
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
      }

      const data = await response.json();
      if (data.success) {
        setSubmitStatus('success');
      } else {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Submission failed');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Booking submission error:', error);
      setSubmitStatus('error');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Reset and close
  const handleClose = () => {
    if (isSubmitting) return;
    setFormData(INITIAL_FORM);
    setErrors({});
    setSubmitStatus('idle');
    onClose();
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center p-4"
      style={{ background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)', backdropFilter: 'blur(8px)' }}
      onClick={handleBackdropClick}
    >
      <div
        ref={modalRef}
        className="relative w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl"
        style={{
          background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #0a0f1a 0%, #020408 100%)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(0,198,255,0.2)',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 40px rgba(0,198,255,0.1)',
        }}
      >
        {/* Close button */}
        <button
          onClick={handleClose}
          disabled={isSubmitting}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 z-10 p-2 rounded-lg text-[#8899AA] hover:text-white hover:bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)] transition-colors disabled:opacity-30"
          aria-label="Close modal"
        >
          <X size={20} />
        </button>

        {/* Success state */}
        {submitStatus === 'success' ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 px-6 text-center">
            <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-6" style={{ background: 'rgba(0,230,118,0.1)' }}>
              <CheckCircle2 size={32} className="text-[#00E676]" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-white text-xl font-bold mb-3">Thank you! We have received your request and will contact you within 24 hours.</h3>
            <p className="text-[#8899AA] text-sm mb-8">We'll review your information and follow up with the next steps.</p>
            <button
              onClick={handleClose}
              className="px-8 py-3 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-[#020408] transition-all hover:scale-105"
              style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #00C6FF, #0072FF)', boxShadow: '0 4px 15px rgba(0,198,255,0.3)' }}
            >
              Close
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Form */
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6 sm:p-8">
            <h2 className="text-white text-xl font-bold mb-1">Book Your Audit</h2>
            <p className="text-[#8899AA] text-sm mb-6">Fill in your details and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.</p>

            {/* Error banner */}
            {submitStatus === 'error' && (
              <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2 text-sm" style={{ background: 'rgba(234,67,53,0.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(234,67,53,0.3)' }}>
                <AlertCircle size={16} className="text-[#EA4335] flex-shrink-0" />
                <span className="text-[#EA4335]">Something went wrong while submitting your request. Please try again.</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Row 1: Full Name | Email */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[#8899AA] text-xs font-medium mb-1.5">Full Name <span className="text-[#EA4335]">*</span></label>
                <input
                  ref={firstInputRef}
                  type="text"
                  value={formData.full_name}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('full_name', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g., John Smith"
                  className="w-full bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.06)] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.1)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-[#556677] focus:outline-none focus:border-[rgba(0,198,255,0.4)] focus:bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)] transition-all"
                  style={errors.full_name ? { borderColor: 'rgba(234,67,53,0.5)' } : {}}
                />
                {errors.full_name && <p className="text-[#EA4335] text-xs mt-1">{errors.full_name}</p>}
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[#8899AA] text-xs font-medium mb-1.5">Email Address <span className="text-[#EA4335]">*</span></label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  value={formData.email}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('email', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g., john@company.com"
                  className="w-full bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.06)] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.1)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-[#556677] focus:outline-none focus:border-[rgba(0,198,255,0.4)] focus:bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)] transition-all"
                  style={errors.email ? { borderColor: 'rgba(234,67,53,0.5)' } : {}}
                />
                {errors.email && <p className="text-[#EA4335] text-xs mt-1">{errors.email}</p>}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Row 2: Phone | Website */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[#8899AA] text-xs font-medium mb-1.5">Phone / WhatsApp</label>
                <input
                  type="tel"
                  value={formData.phone_whatsapp}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('phone_whatsapp', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g., +1 234 567 890"
                  className="w-full bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.06)] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.1)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-[#556677] focus:outline-none focus:border-[rgba(0,198,255,0.4)] focus:bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)] transition-all"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[#8899AA] text-xs font-medium mb-1.5">Website / Store URL <span className="text-[#EA4335]">*</span></label>
                <input
                  type="url"
                  value={formData.website_url}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('website_url', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g., https://yourstore.com"
                  className="w-full bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.06)] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.1)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-[#556677] focus:outline-none focus:border-[rgba(0,198,255,0.4)] focus:bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)] transition-all"
```

```tsx
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * [B] cn() HELPER — dependency-free (no clsx / tailwind-merge needed here)
 * ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function cn(...classes: Array<string | false | null | undefined>): string {
  return classes.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * [C] SOCIAL ICONS — circular icon row, 4 colour variants
 * ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

const iconMap = {
  linkedin: Linkedin,
  whatsapp: MessageCircle,
  github: Github,
  email: Mail,
} as const;

interface SocialIconsProps {
  variant?: "light" | "purple" | "white" | "black";
  bob?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Circular social icon row, matching the reference design's rounded social icons.
 * - light: white circles with purple icons (on light backgrounds)
 * - purple: purple circles with white icons (hero / footer)
 * - white: translucent white circles with white icons (over hero imagery)
 * - black: black circles with white icons (white/black themed sections)
 */
export function SocialIcons({ variant = "purple", bob = true, className }: SocialIconsProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex items-center gap-3", className)} role="list" aria-label="Social media">
      {socialLinks.map((social, i) => {
        const Icon = iconMap[social.icon as keyof typeof iconMap];
        return (
          <a
            key={social.label}
            href={social.href}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            role="listitem"
            aria-label={social.label}
            className={cn(
              "inline-flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1",
              variant === "purple" && "bg-brand text-white hover:bg-brand-light",
              variant === "white" && "border border-white/40 bg-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-brand",
              variant === "light" && "bg-white text-brand shadow-sm hover:bg-surface-soft",
              variant === "black" && "bg-heading text-white hover:bg-black hover:shadow-md",
              bob && "animate-bob"
            )}
            style={bob ? { animationDelay: `${i * 0.15}s` } : undefined}
          >
            <Icon className="h-[18px] w-[18px]" aria-hidden="true" />
          </a>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * [D] CONTACT FORM — full + quick variants, POSTs to /api/contact
 * ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

interface ContactFormProps {
  /** compact variant used inside the contact section (footer quick form) */
  variant?: "full" | "quick";
}

type Status = "idle" | "submitting" | "success" | "error";

/**
 * Contact form — fields mirror the site's real contact form:
 * Name, Email, Store URL (optional), Service, Budget, Message.
 */
export function ContactForm({ variant = "full" }: ContactFormProps) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>("idle");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const isQuick = variant === "quick";

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const form = e.currentTarget;
    const data = new FormData(form);

    setStatus("submitting");
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/contact", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          type: isQuick ? "quick" : "contact",
          name: String(data.get("name") || ""),
          email: String(data.get("email") || ""),
          website: String(data.get("website") || ""),
          service: String(data.get("service") || ""),
          budget: String(data.get("budget") || ""),
          message: String(data.get("message") || ""),
        }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: string } | null;
        throw new Error(body?.error || "Something went wrong. Please try again.");
      }

      setStatus("success");
      form.reset();
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus("error");
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Something went wrong. Please try again.");
    }
  }

  if (status === "success") {
    return (
      <div
        role="status"
        className="rounded-[5px] border border-brand/30 bg-surface-soft p-8 text-center"
      >
        <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-brand">Message sent!</p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-body-text">
          Thank you for reaching out. We&apos;ll get back to you within 24 hours.
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setStatus("idle")}
          className="mt-5 text-sm font-semibold text-brand underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
        >
          Send another message
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const inputBase =
    "w-full rounded-[5px] border border-input bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-heading placeholder:text-body-text/50 transition-colors focus:border-brand focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand/25 disabled:opacity-60";

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate={false}>
      <div className={isQuick ? "flex flex-col gap-4" : "grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"}>
        <div className={isQuick ? "" : "flex flex-col gap-1.5"}>
          <label htmlFor={isQuick ? "q-name" : "c-name"} className="sr-only">
            Name
          </label>
          <input
            id={isQuick ? "q-name" : "c-name"}
            name="name"
            type="text"
            required
            autoComplete="name"
            placeholder="Name *"
            className={inputBase}
          />
        </div>
        <div className={isQuick ? "" : "flex flex-col gap-1.5"}>
          <label htmlFor={isQuick ? "q-email" : "c-email"} className="sr-only">
            Email
          </label>
          <input
            id={isQuick ? "q-email" : "c-email"}
            name="email"
            type="email"
            required
            autoComplete="email"
            placeholder="Email *"
            className={inputBase}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <label htmlFor={isQuick ? "q-website" : "c-website"} className="sr-only">
          Store URL (optional)
        </label>
        <input
          id={isQuick ? "q-website" : "c-website"}
          name="website"
          type="url"
          placeholder="Store URL (optional)"
          className={inputBase}
        />
      </div>

      <div className={isQuick ? "" : "grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <label htmlFor={isQuick ? "q-service" : "c-service"} className="sr-only">
            What do you need help with?
          </label>
          <select
            id={isQuick ? "q-service" : "c-service"}
            name="service"
            required
            defaultValue=""
            className={`${inputBase} appearance-none ${isQuick ? "" : ""}`}
          >
            <option value="" disabled>
              What do you need help with?
            </option>
            {serviceOptions.map((s) => (
              <option key={s} value={s}>
                {s}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <label htmlFor={isQuick ? "q-budget" : "c-budget"} className="sr-only">
            Budget Range
          </label>
          <select
            id={isQuick ? "q-budget" : "c-budget"}
            name="budget"
            defaultValue=""
            className={`${inputBase} appearance-none`}
          >
            <option value="">Budget Range</option>
            {budgetOptions.map((b) => (
              <option key={b} value={b}>
                {b}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
        <label htmlFor={isQuick ? "q-message" : "c-message"} className="sr-only">
          Message
        </label>
        <textarea
          id={isQuick ? "q-message" : "c-message"}
          name="message"
          rows={isQuick ? 3 : 5}
          placeholder="Message"
          className={`${inputBase} resize-y`}
        />
      </div>

      {error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="rounded-[5px] bg-destructive/10 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-destructive">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <button
        type="submit"
        disabled={status === "submitting"}
        className="btn-primary-cta w-full disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-70"
      >
        {status === "submitting" ? "Sending…" : "Send Message"}
        <Send className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}

/**

 * brand + tagline on the left, link columns on the right,
 * deep purple background with lighter form-field tone accents.

  const columns: { title: string; links: readonly { label: string; href: string }[] }[] = [
    { title: "Quick Links", links: footerData.quickLinks },
    { title: "Services", links: footerData.services },
    { title: "Details", links: footerData.detailsSetup },
    { title: "Details", links: footerData.detailsAudits },
  ];

  return (
    <footer className="mt-auto bg-footer-purple text-white">
      {/* Main footer */}
      <div className="container-site grid gap-10 py-14 sm:py-16 lg:grid-cols-[1.3fr_repeat(4,1fr)] lg:gap-8">
        {/* Brand column */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
          <a href="/" className="flex items-center gap-2.5" aria-label="MozIntelligence — Home">
            <img src="/images/logo.png" alt="MozIntelligence logo" width={40} height={40} className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg" />
            <span className="text-xl font-semibold leading-none text-white">
              Moz<span className="text-[#d9c9ff]">Intelligence</span>
            </span>
          </a>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-white/80">
            {site.subtitle}
          </p>
          <p className="max-w-sm text-sm leading-relaxed text-white/85">{site.tagline}</p>
          <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-white">
            {footerData.blurb.split(".")[0]}.<br />
            {footerData.blurb.split(".")[1]?.trim()}.
          </p>
          <SocialIcons variant="white" bob={false} className="mt-1" />
        </div>

        {/* Link columns */}
        {columns.map((col, ci) => (
          <nav key={`${col.title}-${ci}`} aria-label={col.title} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-white">{col.title}</h3>
            <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
              {col.links.map((link) => (
                <li key={link.label}>
                  {/* Use <a> (full page reload) instead of <Link> to avoid
                      client-side navigation state bugs where scroll-reveal
                      animations + dynamic heights break when returning via
                      browser back button. */}
                  <a
                    href={link.href}
                    className="text-sm text-white/85 transition-colors duration-200 hover:text-white hover:underline"
                  >
                    {link.label}
                  </a>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </nav>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Bottom bar */}
      <div className="border-t border-white/15">
        <div className="container-site flex flex-col items-center justify-between gap-3 py-5 text-center sm:flex-row sm:text-left">
          <p className="text-sm text-white/85">{site.copyright}</p>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white/90">{site.motto}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </footer>
  );
}

export function FooterConnectIcon({ icon }: { icon: string }) {
  const Icon = connectIconMap[icon as keyof typeof connectIconMap];
  return Icon ? <Icon className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" /> : null;
}
```

```tsx
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Local class-join helper — replaces the "@/lib/utils" import        */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;
function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  return classes.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

  titleLead: "The Money Was Always There.",
  titleRest: "Nobody Was Looking.",
  /* Aggregate ribbon — every number is taken straight from the cases below */

export type QuickProofData = typeof quickProof;

/* Colour system: black editorial base · green = money outcomes · blue = neutral facts · purple = attribution */
const POSITIVE_LABELS = new Set(["Profit Added", "ROI", "Combined Profit Added", "Return Range"]);

function toneClass(label: string): string {
  return POSITIVE_LABELS.has(label) ? "text-[#047857]" : "text-[#1d4ed8]";
}

/**
 * Quick Proof — three mini case results rendered as an evidence strip:
 * a boxed aggregate summary ribbon, editorial white-board cards with a
 * 4px black side edge + monogram identity, boxed metric tiles and a
 * bottom-anchored quote (purple attribution). Motion: staggered entrance
 * reveal (IntersectionObserver), matching the featured case-studies gallery.
 */
export function QuickProofSection() {
  const data = quickProof;
  const sectionRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);
  const [settled, setSettled] = useState(false);

  /* Reveal animation once the section scrolls into view */
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = sectionRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          obs.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.12 }
    );
    obs.observe(el);
    return () => obs.disconnect();
  }, []);

  /* After the entrance stagger finishes, hand over to snappy hover timings */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!inView) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setSettled(true), data.cases.length * 90 + 900);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [inView, data.cases.length]);

  return (
    <section id="quick-proof"
      ref={sectionRef}
      aria-labelledby="quick-proof-heading"
      className="border-y border-border bg-white py-16 sm:py-24"
    >
      <div className="container-site">
        {/* Editorial header */}
        <div
          className={cn(
            "flex flex-col items-center text-center transition-all",
            settled ? "duration-300" : "duration-700",
            inView ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100" : "translate-y-6 opacity-0"
          )}
        >
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-heading">
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-px w-8 bg-border" />
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-[#047857]" />
            {data.lead}
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-px w-8 bg-border" />
          </span>
          <h2
            id="quick-proof-heading"
            className="mt-4 text-2xl font-semibold leading-tight text-heading lg:text-3xl lg:whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            <span>{data.titleLead}</span>{" "}
            <span>{data.titleRest}</span>
          </h2>
        </div>

        {/* Aggregate summary ribbon — compact stat pills */}
        <div className="mt-10 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3 sm:gap-4">
          {data.summary.map((s, i) => (
            <div
              key={s.label}
              style={{ transitionDelay: settled ? "0ms" : `${120 + i * 70}ms` }}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-baseline gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-border bg-white px-4 py-2 shadow-sm transition-all",
                settled ? "duration-300" : "duration-700",
                inView ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100" : "translate-y-6 opacity-0"
              )}
            >
              <span className={cn("text-sm font-bold tabular-nums sm:text-base", toneClass(s.label))}>
                {s.value}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-body-text/70 sm:text-[11px]">
                {s.label}
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Evidence cards */}
        <div className="mt-12 grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {data.cases.map((c, i) => {
            /* Bold the opening money result — the single most important line */
            const dotIdx = c.result.indexOf(". ");
            const leadIn = dotIdx === -1 ? c.result : c.result.slice(0, dotIdx);
            const tail = dotIdx === -1 ? "" : c.result.slice(dotIdx);
            return (
              <article
                key={c.store}
                style={{ transitionDelay: settled ? "0ms" : `${240 + i * 90}ms` }}
                className={cn(
                  "group relative flex flex-col rounded-[5px] border border-heading/20 border-l-4 border-l-heading bg-white p-6 shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(31,31,31,0.05)] transition-all hover:-translate-y-1.5 hover:border-heading/60 hover:border-l-brand hover:shadow-[0_18px_44px_rgba(31,31,31,0.10)] sm:p-7",
                  settled ? "duration-300" : "duration-700",
                  inView ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100" : "translate-y-8 opacity-0"
                )}
              >
                {/* Index */}
                <span
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className="absolute right-6 top-6 text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] text-heading/35"
                >
                  {String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
                </span>

                {/* Store identity */}
                <div className="relative flex items-center gap-3.5 border-b border-border pb-5">
                  <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[5px] bg-heading text-lg font-semibold text-white"
                  >
                    {c.store.charAt(0)}
                  </span>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-heading">{c.store}</h3>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-body-text">
                      {c.niche}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Narrative + metrics */}
                <div className="relative mt-5 flex flex-1 flex-col">
                  <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-body-text">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-heading">{leadIn}</span>
                    {tail}
                  </p>

                  {/* Metrics — boxed section */}
                  <dl className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-4 rounded-[5px] border border-border bg-surface-soft/50 p-4">
                    {c.metrics.map((m) => (
                      <div key={m.label}>
                        <dt className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-body-text/80">
                          {m.label}
                        </dt>
                        <dd className={cn("mt-1 text-sm font-semibold tabular-nums", toneClass(m.label))}>
                          {m.value}
                        </dd>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </dl>
                </div>

                {/* Quote — boxed section, bottom anchored so boxes align across cards */}
                <figure className="relative mt-5 rounded-[5px] border border-border bg-surface-soft/50 p-4">
                  <Quote aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4 text-[#1d4ed8]/60" />
                  <blockquote className="mt-2 text-sm italic leading-relaxed text-heading">
                    &ldquo;{c.quote}&rdquo;
                  </blockquote>
                  <figcaption className="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold not-italic text-brand">
                    — {c.author}
                  </figcaption>
                </figure>
              </article>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Section CTA */}
        <div
          style={{ transitionDelay: settled ? "0ms" : `${240 + data.cases.length * 90}ms` }}
          className={cn(
            "mt-12 flex justify-center transition-all",
            settled ? "duration-300" : "duration-700",
            inView ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100" : "translate-y-6 opacity-0"
          )}
        >
          <Link href={data.cta.href} className="btn-primary-cta">
            {data.cta.label} <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function FadeIn({
  children,
  className,
  delay = 0,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  delay?: number;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          obs.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.08 }
    );
    obs.observe(el);
    return () => obs.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      style={{ transitionDelay: `${delay}ms` }}
      className={cn(
        "transition-all duration-700 ease-out",
        inView ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100" : "translate-y-8 opacity-0",
        className
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   2) FadeIn — self-contained entrance wrapper (IntersectionObserver,
      threshold 0.08, fade + rise, matching the site-wide language)
---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function FadeIn({
  children,
  className,
  delay = 0,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  delay?: number;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          obs.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.08 }
    );
    obs.observe(el);
    return () => obs.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      style={{ transitionDelay: `${delay}ms` }}
      className={[
        "transition-all duration-700 ease-out",
        inView ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100" : "translate-y-8 opacity-0",
        className,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

                    className="text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums text-white/10"
                  >
                    0{i + 1}
                  </span>
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-white/60">
                    {group.title}
                  </h3>
                  <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-px flex-1 bg-white/[0.08]" />
                  <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-brand-light shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(139,93,255,0.9)]" />
                </div>

                {/* full-bleed ticker (breaks out of the container gutters) */}
                <div className="group relative -mx-4 overflow-hidden [-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to_right,transparent,black_7%,black_93%,transparent)] [mask-image:linear-gradient(to_right,transparent,black_7%,black_93%,transparent)] sm:-mx-6 lg:-mx-8">
                  <div
                    className={`flex w-max ${
                      left ? "animate-ticker-left" : "animate-ticker-right"
                    } group-hover:[animation-play-state:paused] motion-reduce:animate-none ${
                      TICKER_DELAYS[i % TICKER_DELAYS.length]
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      {half.map((item, idx) => (
                        <StackChip key={`${item.name}-a-${idx}`} item={item} />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center" aria-hidden="true">
                      {half.map((item, idx) => (
                        <StackChip key={`${item.name}-b-${idx}`} item={item} />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </FadeIn>
            );
          })}
        </div>

      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

/**
 * One ticker chip — big dark glass tile with a real-colour logo (or a
 * brand-light Lucide icon) next to the verbatim tool name.
 */
function StackChip({ item }: { item: TechItem }) {
  const visual = ITEM_VISUALS[item.name];
  const Icon = visual && "icon" in visual ? visual.icon : null;

  return (
    <div className="mr-3 flex shrink-0 items-center gap-4 rounded-[5px] border border-white/[0.09] bg-white/[0.05] px-5 py-3.5 shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.07),0_10px_28px_rgba(3,2,6,0.45)] transition-all duration-300 hover:border-brand-light/50 hover:bg-white/[0.075] hover:shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.09),0_0_28px_rgba(139,93,255,0.12)]">
      <span className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[4px] border border-white/[0.07] bg-white/[0.06]">
        {visual && "logo" in visual ? (
          <span className="flex items-center">
            <Image
              src={visual.logo}
              alt=""
              width={28}
              height={28}
              unoptimized
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="h-7 w-7 shrink-0 object-contain"
            />
            {visual.secondLogo ? (
              <Image
                src={visual.secondLogo}
                alt=""
                width={24}
                height={24}
                unoptimized
                aria-hidden="true"
                className="-ml-1.5 h-6 w-6 shrink-0 object-contain"
              />
            ) : null}
          </span>
        ) : Icon ? (
          <Icon aria-hidden="true" className="h-6 w-6 text-brand-light" />
        ) : (
          <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-brand-light/50" />
        )}
      </span>
      <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-medium text-white/85">
        {item.name}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";

/* ---------- local utils ---------- */
function cn(...inputs: (string | false | null | undefined)[]) {
  return inputs.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

/* ---------- FadeIn — shared section entrance wrapper ---------- */
function FadeIn({
  children,
  className,
  delay = 0,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  delay?: number;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const obs = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          obs.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.08 }
    );
    obs.observe(el);
    return () => obs.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      style={{ transitionDelay: `${delay}ms` }}
      className={cn(
        "transition-all duration-700 ease-out",
        inView ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100" : "translate-y-8 opacity-0",
        className
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

                      aria-hidden="true"
                      className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[5px] bg-heading text-white"
                    >
                      <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
                    </span>
                    <h4 className="mt-4 text-base font-semibold text-heading">{step.title}</h4>
                    <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-body-text">{step.body}</p>
                  </article>
                </FadeStep>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </FadeIn>

        {/* 3 · Growth impact */}
        <FadeIn className="mt-14 sm:mt-20" delay={60}>
          <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-2 lg:items-center lg:gap-12">
            <div>
              <SubHeading num="03" lead={growth.titleLead} rest={growth.titleRest} restTone="green" />
              <p className="mt-6 max-w-xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-body-text">{growth.lead}</p>
            </div>
            <PhotoFrame
              accent="green"
              src="/images/whatwedo-growth-team.jpg"
              alt="Business team reviewing growth charts together in an office"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="mt-8 grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {growth.items.map((item, i) => {
              const Icon = GROWTH_ICONS[i % GROWTH_ICONS.length];
              return (
                <article
                  key={item.title}
                  className="group flex flex-col rounded-[5px] border border-heading/20 border-l-4 border-l-[#047857] bg-white p-6 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1.5 hover:border-heading/60 hover:border-l-[#047857] hover:shadow-[0_18px_44px_rgba(31,31,31,0.10)]"
                >
                  <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[5px] bg-[#047857] text-white"
                  >
                    <Icon className="h-5 w-5" />
                  </span>
                  <h4 className="mt-4 text-base font-semibold text-heading">{item.title}</h4>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-body-text">{item.body}</p>
                </article>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </FadeIn>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function PhotoFrame({
  src,
  alt,
  className,
  accent,
}: {
  src: string;
  alt: string;
  className?: string;
  accent?: "green";
}) {
  return (
    <figure
      className={cn(
        "relative overflow-hidden rounded-[5px] border border-border bg-white p-2 shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(31,31,31,0.05)]",
        accent === "green" && "border-l-4 border-l-[#047857]",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <div className="relative aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden rounded-[3px]">
        <Image
          src={src}
          alt={alt}
          fill
          sizes="(min-width: 1024px) 560px, 100vw"
          className="object-cover"
        />
      </div>
    </figure>
  );
}

function SubHeading({
  num,
  lead,
  rest,
  restTone = "brand",
}: {
  num?: string;
  lead: string;
  rest: string;
  restTone?: "brand" | "green";
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="mt-1.5 h-6 w-1 shrink-0 rounded-[2px] bg-brand" />
      <div>
        {num && (
          <span
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="block text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-[0.22em] text-heading/35"
          >
            {num}
          </span>
        )}
        <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold leading-snug text-heading sm:text-2xl">
          <span className="text-body-text">{lead}</span>{" "}
          <span className={cn(restTone === "green" ? "text-[#047857]" : "text-brand")}>{rest}</span>
        </h3>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function FadeStep({ index, children }: { index: number; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <>
      <div className={cn(index === 2 ? "sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-1" : undefined)}>{children}</div>
      {index < 2 && (
        <div aria-hidden="true" className="hidden items-center justify-center self-center lg:flex">
          <ArrowRight className="h-6 w-6 text-brand/50" />
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

### FILE: src/hooks/use-mobile.ts
```ts
import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}
```

### FILE: src/hooks/use-toast.ts
```ts
"use client"

// Inspired by react-hot-toast library
import * as React from "react"

import type {
  ToastActionElement,
  ToastProps,
} from "@/components/ui/toast"

const TOAST_LIMIT = 1
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000

type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
  id: string
  title?: React.ReactNode
  description?: React.ReactNode
  action?: ToastActionElement
}

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
} as const

let count = 0

function genId() {
  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
  return count.toString()
}

type ActionType = typeof actionTypes

type Action =
  | {
    type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"]
    toast: ToasterToast
  }
  | {
    type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"]
    toast: Partial<ToasterToast>
  }
  | {
    type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"]
    toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
  }
  | {
    type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"]
    toastId?: ToasterToast["id"]
  }

interface State {
  toasts: ToasterToast[]
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>()

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    return
  }

  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId)
    dispatch({
      type: "REMOVE_TOAST",
      toastId: toastId,
    })
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY)

  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout)
}

export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "ADD_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
      }

    case "UPDATE_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t
        ),
      }

    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {
      const { toastId } = action

      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId)
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id)
        })
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
            ? {
              ...t,
              open: false,
            }
            : t
        ),
      }
    }
    case "REMOVE_TOAST":
      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
        return {
          ...state,
          toasts: [],
        }
      }
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
      }
  }
}

const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = []

let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] }

function dispatch(action: Action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action)
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    listener(memoryState)
  })
}

type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, "id">

function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
  const id = genId()

  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
    dispatch({
      type: "UPDATE_TOAST",
      toast: { ...props, id },
    })
  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id })

  dispatch({
    type: "ADD_TOAST",
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss()
      },
    },
  })

  return {
    id: id,
    dismiss,
    update,
  }
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState)
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState)
      if (index > -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1)
      }
    }
  }, [state])

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId }),
  }
}

export { useToast, toast }
```

```tsx
import * as React from "react"
```

```tsx
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

function Breadcrumb({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"nav">) {
  return <nav aria-label="breadcrumb" data-slot="breadcrumb" {...props} />
}

function BreadcrumbList({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"ol">) {
  return (
    <ol
      data-slot="breadcrumb-list"
      className={cn(
        "text-muted-foreground flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-sm break-words sm:gap-2.5",

      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function BreadcrumbItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"li">) {
  return (
    <li
      data-slot="breadcrumb-item"
      className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1.5", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function BreadcrumbLink({
  asChild,
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"a"> & {
  asChild?: boolean
}) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "a"

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="breadcrumb-link"
      className={cn("hover:text-foreground transition-colors", className)}
      {...props}
    />

}

function BreadcrumbPage({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"span">) {
  return (

      data-slot="breadcrumb-page"
      role="link"
      aria-disabled="true"
      aria-current="page"

      {...props}
    />
  )

function BreadcrumbSeparator({

  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"li">) {
```

```tsx
import * as React from "react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4 shrink-0 [&_svg]:shrink-0 outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 aria-invalid:border-destructive",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default:
          "bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-xs hover:bg-primary/90",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive text-white shadow-xs hover:bg-destructive/90 focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 dark:bg-destructive/60",
        outline:
          "border bg-background shadow-xs hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:bg-input/30 dark:border-input dark:hover:bg-input/50",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground shadow-xs hover:bg-secondary/80",
        ghost:
          "hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground dark:hover:bg-accent/50",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-9 px-4 py-2 has-[>svg]:px-3",
        sm: "h-8 rounded-md gap-1.5 px-3 has-[>svg]:px-2.5",
        lg: "h-10 rounded-md px-6 has-[>svg]:px-4",
        icon: "size-9",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Button({
  className,
  variant,
  size,
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"button"> &
  VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & {
    asChild?: boolean
  }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button"

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="button"
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}
```

### FILE: src/components/ui/carousel.tsx
```tsx
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import useEmblaCarousel, {
  type UseEmblaCarouselType,
} from "embla-carousel-react"
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

type CarouselApi = UseEmblaCarouselType[1]
type UseCarouselParameters = Parameters<typeof useEmblaCarousel>
type CarouselOptions = UseCarouselParameters[0]
type CarouselPlugin = UseCarouselParameters[1]

type CarouselProps = {
  opts?: CarouselOptions
  plugins?: CarouselPlugin
  orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical"
  setApi?: (api: CarouselApi) => void
}

type CarouselContextProps = {
  carouselRef: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[0]
  api: ReturnType<typeof useEmblaCarousel>[1]
  scrollPrev: () => void
  scrollNext: () => void
  canScrollPrev: boolean
  canScrollNext: boolean
} & CarouselProps

const CarouselContext = React.createContext<CarouselContextProps | null>(null)

function useCarousel() {
  const context = React.useContext(CarouselContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useCarousel must be used within a <Carousel />")
  }

  return context
}

function Carousel({
  orientation = "horizontal",
  opts,
  setApi,
  plugins,
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & CarouselProps) {
  const [carouselRef, api] = useEmblaCarousel(
    {
      ...opts,
      axis: orientation === "horizontal" ? "x" : "y",
    },
    plugins
  )
  const [canScrollPrev, setCanScrollPrev] = React.useState(false)
  const [canScrollNext, setCanScrollNext] = React.useState(false)

  const onSelect = React.useCallback((api: CarouselApi) => {
    if (!api) return
    setCanScrollPrev(api.canScrollPrev())
    setCanScrollNext(api.canScrollNext())
  }, [])

  const scrollPrev = React.useCallback(() => {
    api?.scrollPrev()
  }, [api])

  const scrollNext = React.useCallback(() => {
    api?.scrollNext()
  }, [api])

  const handleKeyDown = React.useCallback(
    (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
      if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") {
        event.preventDefault()
        scrollPrev()
      } else if (event.key === "ArrowRight") {
        event.preventDefault()
        scrollNext()
      }
    },
    [scrollPrev, scrollNext]
  )

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!api || !setApi) return
    setApi(api)
  }, [api, setApi])

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!api) return
    onSelect(api)
    api.on("reInit", onSelect)
    api.on("select", onSelect)

    return () => {
      api?.off("select", onSelect)
    }
  }, [api, onSelect])

  return (
    <CarouselContext.Provider
      value={{
        carouselRef,
        api: api,
        opts,
        orientation:
          orientation || (opts?.axis === "y" ? "vertical" : "horizontal"),
        scrollPrev,
        scrollNext,
        canScrollPrev,
        canScrollNext,
      }}
    >
      <div
        onKeyDownCapture={handleKeyDown}
        className={cn("relative", className)}
        role="region"
        aria-roledescription="carousel"
        data-slot="carousel"
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </CarouselContext.Provider>
  )
}

function CarouselContent({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  const { carouselRef, orientation } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <div
      ref={carouselRef}
      className="overflow-hidden"
      data-slot="carousel-content"
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "flex",
          orientation === "horizontal" ? "-ml-4" : "-mt-4 flex-col",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

function CarouselItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  const { orientation } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <div
      role="group"
      aria-roledescription="slide"
      data-slot="carousel-item"
      className={cn(
        "min-w-0 shrink-0 grow-0 basis-full",
        orientation === "horizontal" ? "pl-4" : "pt-4",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function CarouselPrevious({
  className,
  variant = "outline",
  size = "icon",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>) {
  const { orientation, scrollPrev, canScrollPrev } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <Button
      data-slot="carousel-previous"
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={cn(
        "absolute size-8 rounded-full",
        orientation === "horizontal"
          ? "top-1/2 -left-12 -translate-y-1/2"
          : "-top-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90",
        className
      )}
      disabled={!canScrollPrev}
      onClick={scrollPrev}
      {...props}
    >
      <ArrowLeft />
      <span className="sr-only">Previous slide</span>
    </Button>
  )
}

function CarouselNext({
  className,
  variant = "outline",
  size = "icon",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>) {
  const { orientation, scrollNext, canScrollNext } = useCarousel()

  return (
    <Button
      data-slot="carousel-next"
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={cn(
        "absolute size-8 rounded-full",
        orientation === "horizontal"
          ? "top-1/2 -right-12 -translate-y-1/2"
          : "-bottom-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rotate-90",
        className
      )}
      disabled={!canScrollNext}
      onClick={scrollNext}
      {...props}
    >
      <ArrowRight />
      <span className="sr-only">Next slide</span>
    </Button>
  )
}

export {
  type CarouselApi,
  Carousel,
  CarouselContent,
  CarouselItem,
  CarouselPrevious,
  CarouselNext,
}
```
